programme.title: Travel Waes: De Bucketlist / Reizen Waes: de bucketlist
programme.desc: No country in South America where you can still experience the original, indigenous culture as in Bolivia. Upon arrival in La Paz, Tom learns what it is like to live in the highest capital in South America. Thanks to his guide Aracely, he is introduced to the special traditions of the Cholita Culture. Further away from the capital, Tom discovers how diverse Bolivia is: he travels from endless salt plains, along steep mountain paths to the impressive Bolivian rainforest on the border with Brazil. / Geen land in Zuid-Amerika waar je de oorspronkelijke, inheemse cultuur nog zo kan ervaren als in Bolivia. Bij aankomst in La Paz leert Tom wat het is om in de hoogste hoofdstad van Zuid-Amerika te leven. Dankzij zijn gids Aracely maakt hij kennis met de bijzondere tradities van de cholita cultuur. Verder weg van de hoofdstad ontdekt Tom hoe divers Bolivia wel niet is: hij reist van eindeloze zoutvlaktes, langs steile bergpaden tot in het indrukwekkende Boliviaanse regenwoud op de grens met Brazilië.

programme.title: Aloa face the forehead / Alo Alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies in the 1980s, located in the World War II in France occupied by German troops. In the town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Cafe Artois, a place to socialize French, and the Germans. Colonel von Strohm asks Renea to hide in his cafe stolen the image, which he wanted himself at the same time as Hitler. Rene is trying to maintain a balance in his business to satisfy French resistance and the Nazi troops and so he could survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.desc: The humorous Croatian series Ko Šiša follows you Žigmund, owner of an old -fashioned hairdressing salon for gentlemen and goddess, owner of a modern mosque for ladies Kolet, located one across the way, in a square of Zagreb, and are only divided by Taubek. programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.desc: Aleksa lies in the Sarajevo hospital after surgery. He visits him Iva Despić, then a famous painter, and his real portrait. 1918. years are liberation. programme.title: Patirati balls / Punkura
programme.desc: What does public space mean and who else cares about what is out of the screen and four walls? The documentary is investigating the loss of common values ​​through the story of Punkura magazine, created in the middle of a pandemic in Sarajevo. He was launched by sculptor Nardina Zubanović and a journalist Adrian Pečotić, with a recognizable design of Shayle Bratić. Unlike the predecessor of Urban Bug, punkura is financed by donations. The fourth number is in preparation thanks to the support of the Austrian Cultural Forum. The film offers a view from behind the scenes and the Nardina's vision of Sarajevo. / Šta znači javni prostor i kome je još stalo do onoga što postoji van ekrana i četiri zida? Dokumentarni film istražuje gubitak zajedničkih vrijednosti kroz priču o magazinu Punkura, nastalom usred pandemije u Sarajevu. Pokrenuli su ga kiparica Nardina Zubanović i novinar Adrian Pečotić, uz prepoznatljiv dizajn Šejle Bratić. Za razliku od prethodnika Urban Buga, Punkura se finansira donacijama. Četvrti broj je u pripremi zahvaljujući podršci Austrijskog kulturnog foruma. Film nudi pogled iza kulisa i Nardininu viziju Sarajeva.

programme.title: Championship: Obzor / Чемпиъншип: Обзор
programme.desc: A thorough look at the most important events of the English Championship League. Each episode analyzes key matches, big victories, key moments and strategies, with experts sharing their comments and predictions about the future development of the season. / Задълбочен поглед върху най-важните събития от английската Чемпиъншип лига. Във всеки епизод се анализират ключови мачове, големи победи, ключови моменти и стратегии, като експерти споделят своите коментари и прогнози за бъдещото развитие на сезона.

programme.title: Football: Greece Super League: 5 round: Asteras - PAOK / Футбол: Суперлига на Гърция: 5 кръг: Астерас - ПАОК
programme.desc: Founded in 2006, the Greece Super League has become an engine for the development of football in the country. As the highest level of professional football, it attracts the attention of both local and international fans. The success in the Super League opens the doors to the prestigious European club tournaments, where Greek teams have the chance to prove themselves against the best teams in Europe. / Основана през 2006 г., Суперлигата на Гърция се превърна в двигател за развитието на футбола в страната. Като най-високото ниво на професионалния футбол, тя привлича вниманието както на местни, така и на международни фенове. Успехът в Суперлигата отваря вратите към престижните европейски клубни турнири, където гръцките отбори имат шанса да се докажат срещу най-добрите отбори в Европа.

programme.title: Basketball: Supercups for Spain: finale / Баскетбол: Суперкупа на Испания: Финал
programme.desc: The Super Cup of Spain is an annual basketball tournament that opens the season in the country. It features the ACB League Champion, the King's Cup winner, the current Super Cup winner and another team, usually the host or a high -rated team. The tournament is held in the Final Four format with semi -finals and the final within a weekend. It offers fans the first derbies between leading Spanish clubs such as Real Madrid, Barcelona and Valencia and serves as a prelude to the new season. / Суперкупата на Испания е ежегоден баскетболен турнир, който открива сезона в страната. В него участват шампионът на Лига ACB, носителят на Купата на краля, настоящият победител в Суперкупата и още един отбор, обикновено домакинът или тим с висок рейтинг. Турнирът се провежда по формат "финална четворка" с полуфинали и финал в рамките на един уикенд. Той предлага на феновете първите дербита между водещите испански клубове като Реал Мадрид, Барселона и Валенсия и служи като прелюдия към новия сезон.

programme.title: Football: Championship: 7 round: West Bromich Albion - Leicester City / Футбол: Чемпиъншип: 7 кръг: Уест Бромич Албиън - Лестър Сити
programme.desc: Championship is the second level in English football. It consists of 24 teams. The first two teams in the final standings enter the Premier League directly, the other teams to sixth place play a playoff. The last three teams in the ranking fall into the First League. / Чемпиъншип е второто ниво в английския футбол. Състои се от 24 отбора. Първите два тима в крайното класиране влизат директно във Висша лига, останалите отбори до шесто място играят плейоф за влизане. Последните три тима в класирането изпадат в Първа лига.

programme.title: Football: Championship: 7 round: Coventry City - Birmingham City / Футбол: Чемпиъншип: 7 кръг: Ковънтри Сити - Бирмингам Сити

programme.title: Canary Islands: Maintenance of Life / Kanarski otoci: Održavanje života
programme.desc: Les Canaries: des îles sous perfusion - (Nature film, France, 2024) 60 years ago, parts of the first desalinization plant arrived on the Canary Islands, and today the archipelago has more such systems per square meter and per capita than any other area in the world. Desalinized water is key to life in this volcanic area, and has encouraged the unstoppable development of certain branches of the economy, more specifically, mass tourism and intense banana cultivation for exports. But production of such fresh water has its price. For desalinization, it takes a lot of energy, which they get by burning large amounts of oil, and the waste saline concentrate destroys life in the ocean and raises acidity. The documentary for the first time is exploring that the archipelago became completely dependent on desalinized water. Seeks to analyze the disabilities of desalinization and use of such water and measure the effects of the implementation of this method. Residents and researchers have become aware of the necessity of preserving their territory, health and future and heritage they leave to future generations, so they work hard to find an alternative. They seek to save water and improve its exploitation. The experience of the Canary Islands with desalinization allows us to insight into this technology, increasingly popular in the world, and is the foundation for its study. Because the droughts are increasingly frequent and more serious, before or after we will all have to take a stand on desalinization. R .: Yoann Perie Ul.: Laurent Lederer (Self) ... / Les Canaries : Des îles sous perfusion - (prirod. film, Francuska, 2024) Prije 60 godina dijelovi prvog postrojenja za desalinizaciju stigli su na Kanarske otoke, a danas arhipelag ima više takvih sustava po metru četvornome i po stanovniku od bilo kojeg drugog područja na svijetu. Desalinizirana voda ključna je za život na tom vulkanskom području, a potaknula je i nezaustavljivi razvoj određenih grana gospodarstva, konkretnije, masovnog turizma i intenzivnog uzgoja banana za izvoz. No proizvodnja takve slatke vode ima svoju cijenu. Za desalinizaciju treba mnogo energije, koju dobivaju sagorijevanjem velikih količina nafte, a otpadni slani koncentrat uništava život u oceanu i podiže mu kiselost. Dokumentarni film prvi put istražuje kako je arhipelag postao posve ovisan o desaliniziranoj vodi. Nastoji analizirati nedostatke procesa desalinizacije i uporabe takve vode te izmjeriti posljedice provedbe te metode. Stanovnici i istraživači postali su svjesni nužnosti očuvanja svojeg teritorija, zdravlja i budućnosti te naslijeđa koje ostavljaju budućim naraštajima, pa naporno rade na pronalaženju alternativa. Nastoje štedjeti vodu i unaprijediti njezino iskorištavanje. Iskustvo Kanarskih otoka s desalinizacijom omogućuje nam detaljan uvid u tu tehnologiju, sve popularniju u svijetu, i temelj je za njezino proučavanje. Budući da su suše sve učestalije i sve ozbiljnije, prije ili poslije svi ćemo morati zauzeti stajalište o desalinizaciji. R.: Yoann Perie Ul.: Laurent Lederer (Self)...

programme.title: Balara / Balara
programme.desc: Balara - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) Murterin Vedranko Sikic, a family nickname Balar, is a very rare example of "Renaissance Man" for today's time - multiple artistically gifted and active, expressed in drawing, painting, singing, playing, conducting, composing, acting, directing ... And he's completely self -taught! Throughout his creativity, he is inspired by the cultural heritage of the narrowest homeland and living space, the island and the place of Murter - to the extent that for himself, now at the life of a retirement age, he says he is really sorry that he was not born a hundred years earlier! R.: Ivo Kuzmanic ... / Balara - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Murterin Vedranko Šikić, obiteljskim nadimkom Balara, za današnja je vremena već vrlo rijedak primjer "renesansnog čovjeka" - višestruko umjetnički nadaren i aktivan, izražava se crtanjem, slikanjem, pjevanjem, sviranjem, dirigiranjem, skladanjem, glumom, režijom... U svemu podjednako uspješno i kvalitetno, de facto na profesionalnoj razini, a pritom je potpuno samouk! U cijelom svojem stvaralaštvu nadahnut je kulturnom baštinom najužeg zavičaja i životnog prostora, otoka i mjesta Murtera - do te mjere da za sebe, sad već u životnoj dobi umirovljenika, kaže kako mu je zapravo žao što nije rođen sto godina ranije! programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: Third age - (educational program, Croatia) "Doctor, I forget," is a sentence that is difficult to pronounce, and with a diagnosis that confirms doubt is even harder to face. It is estimated that 87,000 people suffer from Alzheimer's and other dementia in Croatia. Care and care for patients are insufficient. Often, they are stigmatized by themselves, members of their families and guardians. Medicines, which can slow down the progression of the disease, are often unavailable to patients due to the price. The support of the local community in the struggle with this serious and incurable disease is of great importance. The newly established Association of Unforgettable in Zagreb is one of the few that will provide the patients with assistance in care and everyday life. Dr. Sanja Klaić Gotić, Head of the Counseling Center for patients with Alzheimer and other dementia of the Health Center East Zagreb and Milenka Petrovic Šekoranja from the KNAP Seniors Club ... will be spoken of today. / Treća dob - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) "Doktore, ja zaboravljam", rečenica je koju je teško izgovoriti, a s dijagnozom koja potvrdi sumnju još se teže suočiti. Procjenjuje se da od Alzheimerove i drugih demencija u Hrvatskoj boluje 87.000 osoba. Skrb i briga za oboljele nedostatne su. Nerijetko su stigmatizirani sami oboljeli, članovi njihovih obitelji i skrbnici. Lijekovi, koji mogu usporiti napredovanje bolesti, često su zbog cijene nedostupni oboljelima. Podrška lokalne zajednice u borbi s ovom teškom i neizlječivom bolesti od velike je važnosti. Novoosnovana udruga Nezaboravak u Zagrebu jedna je od rijetkih koja će oboljelima i njihovim obiteljima pružati pomoć u skrbi i svakodnevici. O ovoj epidemiji današnjice u emisiji će govoriti doktorica Sanja Klaić Grotić, voditeljica savjetovališta za oboljele od Alzheimera i drugih demencija Doma zdravlja Istok Zagreb i Milenka Petrović Šekoranja iz Kluba seniora KNAP-a...

They will show viewers that they can find inspiration at their roots, that they need to be spontaneous and that they need to nurture a sense of home in the kitchen. With the wealth of advice and methods that are the result of many years of experience in the kitchen and at the family table, Lidia will translate his passion for teaching into a fun and credible teaching plan and program that includes a kitchen wisdom. As Lidia says, "to feed himself, his family and friends are one of the most important things in life." Pokazat će gledateljima da nadahnuće mogu pronaći u svojim korijenima, da trebaju biti spontani i da u kuhinji trebaju njegovati osjećaj doma. Uz bogatstvo savjeta i metoda koji su rezultat dugogodišnjeg iskustva u kuhinji i za obiteljskim stolom, Lidia će svoju strast prema poučavanju pretočiti u zabavan i vjerodostojan nastavni plan i program koji obuhvaća kuhinjsku mudrost. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E34, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E34, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Herbs / Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: Plague hunter - (S03, E01, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2021) In the third season, Anton Rudan continues the search for wild, indigenous and alochthonous plants on more famous destinations such as Paklenica National Park, Djurdjevac Sands, Dinara and Valley of the Mirna River, but will surprise viewers and some unexpected, almost unexplored places in Croatia. In addition to the properties and use of various plant species, we will get to know interesting interlocutors and get the idea of ​​how these plants introduce our everyday life. Join us on an adventurous and educational journey and enjoy the spectacular visors of the Natural World of Our Beautiful. ------ a herb hunter is visited by Kalnik, Gora located in northwestern Croatia. In the episode, we get acquainted with the ruins of the old town that keep a multitude of plant world in their walls. Some of the plants in this episode are Bazga, Kravčac, Mak Turčinak, Volunova, Fragrant Shevoj and Kalnički Klinčić. The guests of the episodes are Snjezana Jakopovic, owner of the OPG and Kruno Djurec, a tourist guide. Osim svojstva i upotrebe raznih biljnih vrsta, upoznat ćemo zanimljive sugovornike i dobiti ideju kako te biljke uvesti u našu svakodnevicu. Pridružite nam se na avanturističkom i edukativnom putovanju te uživajte u spektakularnim vizurama prirodnog svijeta Lijepe naše. ----- Lovac na bilje posjećuje Kalnik, goru smještenu u sjeverozapadnoj Hrvatskoj. U epizodi se upoznajemo s ruševinama starog grada koje u svojim zidinama čuvaju mnoštvo biljnog svijeta. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su bazga, kravčac, mak turčinak, volovod, mirisni šeboj i kalnički klinčić. Gosti epizode su Snježana Jakopović, vlasnica OPG-a te Kruno Đurec, turistički vodič. programme.title: Maze / Labirint
programme.desc: Labyrinth - (Talk Show, Croatia) in the heart of our granary, fertile Slavonia and Baranja, from Andrijasevci to Novi Ceminac after the wheat harvest instead of joy - silence and bitterness. So it was this summer! In the land of galloping inflation, the purchase price of wheat has not changed for decades. Moreover, the question echoes - then why do we eat such expensive bread? The documentary film "Grain of Truth" indicates the absurdity of Croatian agriculture, which becomes impact news only when the peasants protest and perform tractors from the field on the roads. Why does homemade wheat export for small money, while expensive to sell imports of imported baker's products that have flooded our market? Why, even though we have produced cheap homemade wheat for decades, we pay more expensive and more expensive bread, those whose efforts melt on the way from field to table. The answers to the questions of why the peasant fails, the traders make money, and the state is silent as the strategies and the line ministers are unsuccessfully changing, in the first edition of this season's Labyrinth, the author Sanja Mikleušević Pavić is sought. R .: Slavica Grahovar ... / Labirint - (talk show, Hrvatska) U srcu naše žitnice, plodne Slavonije i Baranje, od Andrijaševaca do Novog Čeminca nakon žetve pšenice umjesto veselja - tišina i gorčina. Tako je bilo i ovoga ljeta! U zemlji galopirajuće inflacije otkupna cijena pšenice desetljećima se nije mijenjala. Tim više odzvanja pitanje - zašto onda jedemo tako skup kruh? Dokumentarni film "Zrno istine" ukazuje na apsurd hrvatske poljoprivrede koji postaje udarna vijest tek kada seljaci prosvjeduju i izvedu traktore s polja na ceste. Zašto domaća pšenica ide u izvoz za sitne novce, dok nam skupo prodaju uvozne pekarske proizvode koji su preplavili naše tržište? Zašto, iako već desetljećima proizvodimo jeftinu domaću pšenicu, plaćamo sve skuplji i skuplji kruh, govore oni čiji se trud topi na putu od polja do stola. Odgovore na pitanja zašto seljak propada, trgovci zarađuju, a država šuti dok bezuspješno mijenja strategije i resorne ministre, u prvom izdanju ovosezonskog Labirinta traži autorica Sanja Mikleušević Pavić. R.: Slavica Grahovar...

programme.title: Parenting in the animal world / Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Parenthood - (E01, Nature. Film, England, 2025) Parenting is a journey like no other - a lot of danger and gains. Each habitat has a unique set of problems, and each parent is a unique strategy for solving them. But roles are such that they cannot be greater - success for parents means the future of life on our planet. Searching for a suitable home is the first task. In Kalahari lionesses, they survive by helping each other in lifting cubs in difficult times. These mothers are eliminated by additional danger because they have to learn the cubs and to hunt ugly. Elsewhere, in Texas, a couple of Jamar's Cukova raises birds in an underground nest that protects them as their parents bring them food around the clock. Food is key to the success of all parents - but the female of Vodenjanje in Tanzania must leave the safety of her lake every night to look for the grass for herself and her cub - and run with her newcomer cubs between the hungry lions hidden in the dark. R .: Jeff Wilson Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (narrator) ... / Parenthood - (E01, prirod. film, Engleska, 2025) Roditeljstvo je putovanje poput nijednog drugog - puno opasnosti i dobitaka. Svako stanište ima jedinstven skup problema, a svaki roditelj jedinstvenu strategiju za njihovo rješavanje. No ulozi su takvi da ne mogu biti veći - uspjeh za roditelje znači budućnost života na našem planetu. Traženje prikladnog doma prvi je zadatak. U Kalahariju lavice preživljavaju tako što si međusobno pomažu u podizanju mladunaca u teškim vremenima. Te se majke izvrgavaju dodatnoj opasnosti jer moraju mladunce naučiti i da love grdosije. Drugdje, u Teksasu, par ćukova jamara podiže ptiće u podzemnom gnijezdu koje ih štiti dok im roditelji danonoćno donose hranu. Hrana je ključna za uspjeh svih roditelja - ali ženka vodenkonja u Tanzaniji svake večeri mora napustiti sigurnost svojeg jezera kako bi potražila travu za sebe i svoje mladunče - i trčati sa svojim novopridošlim mladunčetom između gladnih lavova skrivenih u mraku. R.: Jeff Wilson Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narator)...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E34, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E34, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: Third age - (educational program, Croatia) "Doctor, I forget," is a sentence that is difficult to pronounce, and with a diagnosis that confirms doubt is even harder to face. It is estimated that 87,000 people suffer from Alzheimer's and other dementia in Croatia. Care and care for patients are insufficient. Often, they are stigmatized by themselves, members of their families and guardians. Medicines, which can slow down the progression of the disease, are often unavailable to patients due to the price. The support of the local community in the struggle with this serious and incurable disease is of great importance. The newly established Association of Unforgettable in Zagreb is one of the few that will provide the patients with assistance in care and everyday life. Dr. Sanja Klaić Gotić, Head of the Counseling Center for patients with Alzheimer and other dementia of the Health Center East Zagreb and Milenka Petrovic Šekoranja from the KNAP Seniors Club ... will be spoken of today. / Treća dob - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) "Doktore, ja zaboravljam", rečenica je koju je teško izgovoriti, a s dijagnozom koja potvrdi sumnju još se teže suočiti. Procjenjuje se da od Alzheimerove i drugih demencija u Hrvatskoj boluje 87.000 osoba. Skrb i briga za oboljele nedostatne su. Nerijetko su stigmatizirani sami oboljeli, članovi njihovih obitelji i skrbnici. Lijekovi, koji mogu usporiti napredovanje bolesti, često su zbog cijene nedostupni oboljelima. Podrška lokalne zajednice u borbi s ovom teškom i neizlječivom bolesti od velike je važnosti. Novoosnovana udruga Nezaboravak u Zagrebu jedna je od rijetkih koja će oboljelima i njihovim obiteljima pružati pomoć u skrbi i svakodnevici. O ovoj epidemiji današnjice u emisiji će govoriti doktorica Sanja Klaić Grotić, voditeljica savjetovališta za oboljele od Alzheimera i drugih demencija Doma zdravlja Istok Zagreb i Milenka Petrović Šekoranja iz Kluba seniora KNAP-a...

programme.desc: DULUM Earth - (S04, E01, Educational Program, Croatia, 2025) The fourth season of the series with a new six episodes arrives! We will get to know Elijah Juric, who enriches our gastronomy around Zagreb with a gastronomy by gastronomy by gastronomy, Bjelovarka Sandra Cerjanec whose horses change their lives, we will visit the island agricultural paradise of the Žumer family on Dugi Otok, shakes that all bees can spend time from Jagod to Batata in Šiškovci in Šiškovci in Šiškovci, Blueberry with the Lisjak family near Čakovec. Through personal stories, the efforts, perseverance and visions of these farmers are shown, with an emphasis on the importance of family values, community and respect for nature. All episodes of the series are available on the HRTi platform. You can follow the currentness on social networks channels: Facebook and Instagram. ----- The story of Elijah Juric begins in the family garden where he learned from his parents first steps in agriculture. Over time, he turned his knowledge into his own path, developing the cultivation of micro -fences, edible flowers and exotic plants, which today enrich the top cuisine in Croatia. We will see how young farmers, relying on tradition, can create innovative models of business and open a new gastronomy door. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E35, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E35, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

Film, England) In this episode, we find out what has a new one with two pairs that have sought more space to live. 2019 we met Becky and Adam. After saving for the deposit, they started looking for a family home in Essex, which they could renovate and arrange to their taste. Phil Spencer found a wonderful house for an adaptation in Tollesbury, but after their purchase they would not have money left to remodel. Tensed negotiations followed. In the end, thanks to Phil's skill, they managed to reach an agreement. He decided to visit them four years later and discovered that there was fewer and fewer space in the once spacious house. The couple got married, got a dog and a cat, and this year they got a daughter Amar. In 2021, King and Dave also sought more space. They decided to move from their apartment in London to Leeds to be closer to families and embark on a search for a house with a garden where their two -year -old daughter Lily could play ... / Location, Location, Location - (S27, E11, dok. film, Engleska) U ovoj epizodi doznajemo što ima nova kod dva para koji su tražili više prostora za život. 2019. upoznali smo Becky i Adama. Nakon što su uštedjeli za polog, počeli su tražiti obiteljsku kuću u Essexu koju bi mogli renovirati i urediti po svom ukusu. Phil Spencer im je pronašao prekrasnu kuću za adaptaciju u Tollesburyju, no nakon kupnje ne bi im ostalo novca za preuređenje. Uslijedili su napeti pregovori. Na kraju su, zahvaljujući Philovoj umješnosti, uspjeli postići dogovor. Odlučio ih je obići četiri godine poslije i otkrio da u nekad prostranoj kući ima sve manje mjesta. Par se vjenčao, nabavio psa i mačku, a ove su godine dobili i kćer Amaru. Godine 2021. Kinga i Dave također su tražili više prostora. Odlučili su se preseliti iz svog stana u Londonu u Leeds kako bi bili bliže obitelji te krenuli u potragu za kućom s vrtom u kojem bi se njihova dvogodišnja kći Lily mogla igrati...

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Design - Australia / Čudesni svijet dizajna - Australija
programme.desc: Grand Designs Australia - (S11, E03, known. Pop. Series, Australia, 2024) Is there better for two skilled and creative architects to build their eternal dream home? The dream of a married couple Gaurava and Vish, who first work together on the project, is to build a multigeneration home for the whole family at MT Waverley, Victoria. Indians, born and raised in Mumbai, are eager for greenery and raised culturally in an environment where more generations live together and where young people care for their elderly, and designed the house for themselves and children with once again for their parents who will come from India when the house is completed. The peculiarity of these two houses is that the whole terracotta tiles are lined with tile, to have a central yard with a pool that will be a gathering place for the whole family and the beautiful mahogany tree at the end of the yard. The house is built of SIP panels that reduce the time and cost of construction, but have their flaws very much, which Gaurav and Vish personally became convinced. Ul.: Anthony Burke (Self - Present) ... / Grand Designs Australia - (S11, E03, znan. pop. serija, Australija, 2024) Ima li bolje od toga da dvoje vještih i kreativnih arhitekata grade svoj vječni dom iz snova? San bračnog para Gaurava i Vish koji prvi put zajedno rade na projektu, jest da sagrade multigeneracijski dom za cijelu obitelj u Mt Waverleyju, u Victoriji. Indijci, rođeni i odgojeni u Mumbaiju, željni su zelenila i odgojeni kulturološki u sredini u kojoj više naraštaja žive zajedno i gdje se mladi brinu za svoje starije pa su projektirali kuću za sebe i djecu s još jednom za svoje roditelje koji će doći iz Indije kad kuća bude dovršena. Osobitost tih dviju kuća jest da cijele budu obložene terakota pločicama, da imaju središnje dvorište s bazenom koje će biti okupljalište cijele obitelji i prekrasim stablom mahagonija na kraju dvorišta. Kuća je izgrađena od SIP panela koji smanjuju vrijeme i troškove gradnje, ali imaju itekako svoje mane, u što su se osobno uvjerili Gaurav i Vish. Ul.: Anthony Burke (Self - Presenter)...

programme.title: Alana Titchmarsha Garden Club / Vrtlarski klub Alana Titchmarsha
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarshs Gardening Club - (S02, E06, Entertainment Program, England, 2025) Alan Titchmarsh and his team from a gardening club bring us a new season of a series full of practical tips, professional tricks and inspirational stories, celebrating the joy of gardening throughout the United Kingdom. The series brings gardens of all sizes - from urban spaces to celebrity parks - with an emphasis on sustainable and common gardening, and will give answers to the viewers' questions about everything that has to do with the garden. Alan is joined by horticulturalists Camilla Bassett-Smith and Errol Reuben Fernandes, Urban Garden Jason Williams, Claire Lowrie, Ecological Gardener Anna Greenland and Landscape Architect Henry Agg, who share their knowledge to help and maintain their own sake oases. R .: Luke Rowbotham Ul.: Errol Reuben Fernandes (Self), Claire Lowrie (Self), Huw Richards (Self), Camilla Bassett-Smith (Self), Lucy Chamberlain (Self) ... / Alan Titchmarshs Gardening Club - (S02, E06, zabavni program, Engleska, 2025) Alan Titchmarsh i njegov tim iz Vrtlarskog kluba donose nam novu sezonu serije punu praktičnih savjeta, stručnih trikova i inspirativnih priča, koje slave radost vrtlarstva diljem Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva. Serija donosi vrtove svih veličina - od urbanih prostora do slavnih perivoja - s naglaskom na održivo i zajedničko vrtlarstvo, a dat će i odgovore na pitanja gledatelja o svemu što ima veze s vrtom. Alanu se pridružuju hortikulturisti Camilla Bassett-Smith i Errol Reuben Fernandes, urbani vrtlar Jason Williams, stručnjakinja za sobne biljke Claire Lowrie, ekološka vrtlarica Anna Greenland i krajobrazni arhitekt Henry Agg, koji dijele svoje znanje kako bi pomogli gledateljima uzgojiti, oblikovati i održavati vlastite zelene oaze. R.: Luke Rowbotham Ul.: Errol Reuben Fernandes (Self), Claire Lowrie (Self), Huw Richards (Self), Camilla Bassett-Smith (Self), Lucy Chamberlain (Self)...

He learned from the world's best chefs, and later taught himself some of the best chefs of today. In this series dedicated to practical cooking at home, Gordon will throw out complexity and great effort from the preparation of meals and teach us how hundreds of simple, affordable and modern disappointments are prepared to prepare us. R .: Paul Ratcliffe ... / Gordon Ramsays Ultimate Cookery Course - (E05, znan. pop. serija, Engleska, 2012) Gordon Ramsay radi u profesionalnim kuhinjama više desetljeća. Učio je od ponajboljih svjetskih kuhara, a poslije je i sam poučavao neke od najboljih kuhara današnjice. U ovoj seriji posvećenoj praktičnom kuhanju kod kuće, Gordon će iz pripreme jela izbaciti složenost i veliki napor te nas naučiti kako se priprema stotina jednostavnih, pristupačnih i modernih jela koja nas neće razočarati. R.: Paul Ratcliffe...

programme.title: A new start with Ben Fogle / Novi početak s Benom Fogleom
programme.desc: Ben Fogle: Make a New Life in the Country - (S02, E06, Educational Program, England, 2022) The second season of the series in which Ben Fogle introduces us to adventure people who left work in the city, sold everything, went to the countryside and started a new life there. Ben has been following them for a full year - they will see how they left the city, invested savings in starting a new job and risked everything so they could be their masters themselves, live in a beautiful landscape and do what they love. She learns what obstacles they face and what their new everyday life looks like, and in a year it will reveal if the risk has paid off and whether the reality has fulfilled her expectations. R .: Lindsay Brown ... / Ben Fogle: Make a New Life in the Country - (S02, E06, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Druga sezona serije u kojoj nas Ben Fogle upoznaje s pustolovnim ljudima koji su ostavili posao u gradu, prodali sve, otišli na selo i ondje počeli novi život. Ben ih prati punu godinu dana - vidjet će kako su otišli iz grada, uložili ušteđevinu u pokretanje novog posla i sve riskirali kako bi mogli biti sami svoji gospodari, živjeti u lijepom krajoliku i raditi ono što vole. Doznaje s kakvim se zaprekama susreću i kako izgleda njihova nova svakodnevica, a za godinu dana otkrit će je li se rizik isplatio i je li stvarnost ispunila očekivanja. R.: Lindsay Brown...

programme.title: Endeavour - Young Morse / Endeavour - Mladi Morse
programme.desc: Endeavor - (S06, E02, Played Series, England, 2019) The Star Society from Station Cowley is scattered across Oxfordshire, and Endeavor is reluctant to get used to peaceful life in the rural. Thursday is dissatisfied with a new position in the enemy station of Castle Gate with the former rival of the Higher Inspector of Ronnie Box and his new Assistant Sergeant Alan Jag. Strange received a function in the Police Directorate, and Bright was moved to traffic. Only faithful Max remained in the morgue. Nothing is like before. Summer love has been past and it seems to be 1969. years will be darker and challenging than any before. It seems unlikely that the old team from Cowley will ever meet again until a series of cruel crimes do not connect again Edeavoura, Thursday and others. Р.: Shaun Evans Ul.: Shaun Evans (DS Endeavor Morse), Roger Allam), Sean Rigby (DS Jim Strange), James BradShaw, Anton Lesser (Chief Superintendent Reginaldd Bright) ... / Endeavour - (S06, E02, igrana serija, Engleska, 2019) Staro društvo iz postaje Cowley raštrkano je diljem Oxfordshirea, a Endeavour se nerado navikava na miran život u seoskoj zabiti. Thursday je nezadovoljan novim položajem u neprijateljskoj postaji Castle Gate uz bivšeg suparnika višeg inspektora Ronnieja Boxa i njegovog novog pomoćnika narednika Alana Jaga. Strange je dobio funkciju u upravi policije, a Bright je premješten u Prometnu. Samo je vjerni Max ostao u mrtvačnici. Ništa nije kao prije. Ljeto ljubavi zauvijek je prošlo i čini se da će 1969. godina biti mračnija i izazovnija nego ijedna prije. Čini se malo vjerojatno da će se stara ekipa iz Cowleya ikad opet susresti dok niz okrutnih zločina ponovno ne spoji Edeavoura, Thursdaya i ostale. R.: Shaun Evans Ul.: Shaun Evans (DS Endeavour Morse), Roger Allam (DI Fred Thursday), Sean Rigby (DS Jim Strange), James Bradshaw (Dr. Max McBryn), Anton Lesser (Chief Superintendent Reginald Bright)...

programme.title: Just lightly / Samo lagano
programme.desc: Just lightly - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2025) "Happiness is - to be with nature, watch it and talk to it." - The words are Lav Nikolajevic Tolstoy. The whole wonderful world is just behind our windows, and it would be recklessly missing it! Still, too often we forget to make that step ... to walk among the trees (and even in the park) and take a deep breath. That is why today we will talk about nature and natural. Be with us and ... just lightly! ... / Samo lagano - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) "Sreća je - biti s prirodom, gledati je i s njom govoriti." - riječi su Lava Nikolajevića Tolstoja. Cijeli jedan čudesan svijet nalazi se odmah iza naših prozora, i bilo bi nepromišljeno propustiti ga! Ipak, prečesto zaboravljamo učiniti taj korak... ušetati među stabla (pa čak i u parku) i duboko udahnuti. Zato ćemo danas razgovarati o prirodi i prirodnom. Budite s nama i... SAMO LAGANO!...

In Scotland, our deer made the first miles with Audi Q3. We were in Frankfurt on the premiere of the hybrid kgm Torres. Branimir tested by BYD SEALION 7. For the end, we make maintenance advice and explain what is the difference between a large and small service. Stay with us ... / Auto Market Magazin - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Neven Novak isprobao je potpuno električni MG S5. Posjetili smo svjetsku premijeru novog Renault Clia u Parizu. U Škotskoj je naša Jelena napravila prve kilometre s Audijem Q3. U Frankfurtu smo bili na premijeri hibridnog KGM Torresa. Branimir je testirao BYD Sealion 7. Za kraj donosimo savjete za održavanje i objašnjavamo koja je razlika između velikog i malog servisa. Ostanite uz nas...

programme.title: We discover Croatia / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku
programme.desc: We discover Croatia - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2025) a documentary about charms shows a life in a small town in the center of the island of Korcula, which connects tradition and modern life in the best possible way. The story of the Krajančić family vineyard shows the cultivation of old grape varieties and a modern processing mode. In charm, we witness the preservation of old customs, dances and legends in accordance with the modern way of life and work. The sock is located in the heart of the island of Korcula and is one of the oldest places on the island. It is located on a hill below which is a large Čarško field on which a parip, an autochthonous grape variety of which has been produced for centuries, has been produced by a unique Posip wine. Apart from the wine, the sock is widely known for the churches of long and rich history, almonds, great cypress and legends. In the charm we also filmed the Crnomir Brothers Cultural and Art Society, named after the legendary brothers who once boldly fought for the rights of peasants against the Venetian nobility and prince. In charms, returnees, people who have found their home again here from far Australia and America ... / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Dokumentarni film o Čari prikazuje život u malom mjestu u središtu otoka Korčule u kojem se spajaju tradicija i suvremeni život na najbolji mogući način. Priča o obiteljskom vinogradu Krajančića prikazuje uzgoj starih sorti grožđa i suvremeni način prerade. U Čari svjedočimo očuvanju starih običaja, plesova i legendi u skladu sa suvremenim načinom života i rada. Čara se nalazi u srcu otoka Korčule i jedno je od najstarijih mjesta na otoku. Smještena je na brdu ispod kojeg se nalazi veliko Čarsko polje na kojem se uzgaja pošip, autohtona sorta grožđa od kojeg se već stoljećima proizvodi jedinstveno vino pošip. Osim po vinu, Čara je nadaleko poznata po crkvicama duge i bogate povijesti, bademima, velikom čempresu i legendama. U Čari smo snimili i kulturno-umjetničko društvo Braća Črnomir koje je ime dobilo po legendarnoj braći koja su se nekada davno hrabro borila za prava seljaka protiv mletačkog plemstva i kneza. U Čari žive i povratnici, ljudi koji su iz daleke Australije i Amerike ovdje ponovno našli svoj dom...

programme.title: Rijeka: Sea / Rijeka: More
programme.desc: Rijeka: Sea - (Nature. Film, Croatia, 2025) There is almost no corner on a planet without plastic. She does not bypass our Adriatic either. What makes the Adriatic - we checked at the Sea Research Center in Rovinj. We travel to the Kvarner islands. On the island of Mala Srakana, there used to be about 50, and today only two people. programme.desc: Brazilian splendor in the alps - (Doc. Film, Austria, 2023) Today, Schladming is a well -known skiing destination, but did you know that the City Hall is located in a magnificent castle and that the Kruna stone on the second floor referred to the Brazilian Empire? Director Alexander Frohner reveals this secret to Schladming, following the trace of the descendants of the Austrian Archduke Leopoldine from Brazil to Austria. One of her heirs made Schladming with his main residence and attracted an international high nobility and artists from the entire Austro-Hungarian Empire to this alpine city. Redatelj Alexander Frohner razotkriva ovu tajnu Schladminga, prateći trag potomaka austrijske nadvojvotkinje Leopoldine od Brazila do Austrije. Jedan od njezinih nasljednika učinio je Schladming svojim glavnim prebivalištem i u ovaj alpski grad privukao međunarodno visoko plemstvo i umjetnike iz cijelog Austro-Ugarskog Carstva. R.: Alexander Frohner...

programme.title: Cyrano / Cyrano
programme.desc: Cyrano - (Film, USA, 2021) The original drama of Edmond Rostand Cyrano de Bergerac of 1897. The most famous one is from the 1990 one with Gerard Darardieu in the title role, epic and classic, faithfully adapted, rich bones and impressive mass scenes. In this version, which relies on the theatrical musical of 2018, dialogues are partially replaced by musical numbers, and the physical handicap from the upgraded departieu nose was transferred to the low stature of Peter Dinlage. In addition, the staff are more intimate, with more focus on characters, stylization is almost fairytale, interpretation romantic. Criticism praised Dinclage's emotional performance and music, but the film did not go well in cinemas, partly because of Covid. Najpoznatija je ona iz ona iz 1990. s Gerardom Depardieuom u naslovnoj ulozi, epska i klasična, vjerno adaptirana, bogatih kostima i impresivnih masovnih prizora. U ovoj su pak verziji koja se oslanja na kazališni mjuzikl iz 2018. dijalozi djelomično zamijenjeni glazbenim brojevima, a fizički je hendikep s dograđenog Depardieuova nosa prebačen na nizak stas Petera Dinklagea. Usto, kadrovi su intimniji, s više fokusa na likovima, stilizacija je gotovo bajkovita, interpretacija romantična. I možda vam ovo sve zvuči kao neka dogodovština s maturalca, mi zapravo samo pratimo zgode usamljenog viteza Don Quijotea i njegovog vjernog štitonoše Sancha Panze u istoimenom književnom djelu Miguela de Cervantesa. programme.title: Frano Parać: Judita, Opera - HNK Zagreb / Frano Parać: Judita, opera - HNK Zagreb
programme.desc: Frano Parać: Judita, Opera - HNK Zagreb - (Croatia, 2024) In the year of Marko Marulić, in which we mark the 500th anniversary of the death of the father of Croatian literature, we bring an opera hit by Croatian composer and academician Fran Parać, a kind of rarity among contemporary Croatian opera, not only on the unprecedented reception of the audience, but also on the number of renovation. 2000. The new inservation of Juda, which we recorded on our cameras on October 5, 2024 at the Croatian National Theater, and directed by Snježana Banović and under the conductor of Ivan Josip Skender, once again represents this opera work that can stand side by side with the operas of contemporary music. Judita is the first literary EP in the Croatian language, it was written in 1501, and published on April 2, 1521, on the occasion of which this date became the day of the Croatian Book. Marulić and Paraćev Judita thematizes the story taken from the Bible book on Judita, about a beautiful widow from Betuli who decides to seduce and kill the Assyrian military leader of the Oloferna, thus saving the Jewish people. In the camp of the Assyrian army, she persuades the Oloferna to conquer Betulia, and the Oloferne, blinded by Judita's beauty and wisdom, for her to have fun. Leaving alone with a drunken Olofer, Judita kills him with his sword, taking as a proof of the Olofern head. Judita, the brightest gem of our literature, which Marulić represents as an example to the people to make it aware of what faith in God, and justice at the time of the danger of the Turks penetrates, is performed by Parac in two acts and seven paintings. The composer Parac, with the help of the former dramatization of Judite Marin Caric, and in collaboration with Tonka Maroevic, assumes the role of the Librestist, uniting the former Wagner's ideal of composer-Libretist. R .: Danko Volarić ... / Frano Parać: Judita, opera - HNK Zagreb - (Hrvatska, 2024) U godini Marka Marulića, u kojoj obilježavamo 500. obljetnicu smrti oca hrvatske književnosti, donosimo opernu uspješnicu hrvatskog skladatelja i akademika Frane Paraća, svojevrsni raritet među suvremenim hrvatskim operama, ne samo po nezapamćenoj recepciji publike, već i po broju obnova koje su uslijedile nakon praizvedbe iz 2000. Nova inscenacija Judite, koju smo našim kamerama zabilježili 5. listopada 2024. u HNK Zagreb, a u režiji Snježane Banović i pod dirigentskim vodstvom Ivana Josipa Skendera, još jednom predstavlja ovo operno djelo koje može ravnopravno stati uz bok opernim tekovinama suvremene glazbe. Judita je prvi književni ep na hrvatskom jeziku, napisana je 1501., a objavljena 22. travnja 1521. godine, povodom čega taj datum postaje i Danom hrvatske knjige. Marulićeva i Paraćeva Judita tematizira priču preuzetu iz biblijske Knjige o Juditi, o lijepoj udovici iz Betulije koja odlučuje zavesti i ubiti asirskog vojskovođu Oloferna i tako spasiti židovski narod. U taboru asirske vojske ona nagovara Oloferna da osvoji Betuliju, a Oloferne, zaslijepljen Juditinom ljepotom i mudrošću, za nju priređuje zabavu. Ostavši sama s pijanim Olofernom, Judita ga ubija njegovim mačem, uzevši kao dokaz Olofernovu glavu. Juditu, najsjajniji dragulj naše književnosti, koju Marulić predstavlja kao primjer narodu da osvijeste što može učiniti vjera u Boga, i pravdu u vrijeme opasnosti od prodora Turaka, Parać izvodi u dva čina i sedam slika. Skladatelj Parać, uz pomoć nekadašnje dramatizacije Judite Marina Carića, a u suradnji s Tonkom Maroevićem, preuzima ulogu libretista, ujedinivši time nekadašnji Wagnerov ideal skladatelja-libretista. R.: Danko Volarić...

programme.desc: Sea, olive and vine: salty and sweet - (E02, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2002) What a frightening sea looks like when its waves stuck with storm rolling boats in Lucice as a straw, and then suddenly silences, calls his beauty to some magical, almost inexplicable power. In the small sea, as they call the Ston Bay, the living oyster, allegedly a Croatian product for the 21st century. This shell full of phosphorus and iron is the desire of many gourmets across Europe, and the hosts filled with the fear of a black plague in the bay invoke wit and power to keep that pearl of our sea. The vineyards and olives are the following low our island beauty from which hard work and love springs, spiced with warm winds of the south. "In my dreams, I have drawn in my dreamers of vineyards and olive Arabeska, combing the grape lace and listening to laughter in drinking wine, white and black, young and old, calm and sparkling, trying to grasp this mysterious harmony of the earth and the vine, heaven and man, because he is almost erotic in these territories in these territories. intoxication and traditional consistency expressed his existential surrender of vine and wine, vine and olives, "wrote prof. Dr. Mirošević. There is a long tradition of viticulture and olive growing in the Mediterranean. For millennia, the smell of wine and oil, fish and salt has been mixed, life flows through four harvests, sweet and salty, never cute and easily, more often difficult, sometimes pressed. U Malom moru, kako zovu Stonski zaljev, živi kamenica, navodno hrvatski proizvod za 21. stoljeće. Ta školjka puna fosfora i željeza želja je mnogih sladokusaca diljem Europe, a domaćini ispunjeni strahom od crne kuge u zaljevu prizivaju pamet i vlast da čuvaju taj biser našeg mora. Vinogradi i masline sljedeće su niske naše otočke ljepote iz kojih izvire težački rad i ljubav, začinjen toplim vjetrovima juga. "Čitavog sam svog života u svojim sanjarijama iscrtavao vinogradarske i maslinarske arabeske, pročešljavao grožđane čipke i osluškivao smijeh u ispijanju vina, bijelog i crnog, mladog i starog, mirnog i iskričavog, pokušavajući dokučiti tu misterioznu harmoniju zemlje i loze, neba i čovjeka, jer on je vjekovima na ovim našim prostorima gotovo erotskom senzualnošću, sugestivnom opijenošću i tradicijskom dosljednošću iskazivao svoje egzistencijalno predanje lozi i vinu, lozi i maslini", napisao je prof. dr. Mirošević. Duga je tradicija vinogradarstva i maslinarstva na Mediteranu. Već tisućljećima miješa se miris vina i ulja, ribe i soli, život teče kroz četiri berbe, slatko i slano, nikad preslatko i lako, češće teško, ponekad preslano. R.: Dominik Zen...

programme.title: The worst witch / Najgora vještica
programme.desc: The Worst Witch - (S02, E07, Children's Program, England, 2018) Mildred goes to Cackle school again, but much more skilled than before. The foundation stone, from which the schools for witches draw their magical power, was finally found. Esmerelda comes to a visit to Ethel, who persuades her to take over the magical power of stone, which this refuses. But in order to save their younger sister Sybil, Esmerelda did so in the end, after which things move wrong and the castle soon found herself shackled with ice. While Mildred, Maud, Enid and the Hallow sisters are trying to find a way to "revive" the cornerstone, Mildred ran into their family tree. She reveals that she comes from a witch family, but that her ancestor Mirabelle Hubble, as well as the next 12 generations, had to give up her powers to re -breathe life with a stone foundation. After evacuating everything so that they do not freeze, Mildred realizes that she has to do the same if she wants to save school. She starts soot, but before he manages to say the magic to the end, the professor of art, Mrs. Mold, jumps into her place and sacrifices her powers. Kamen temeljac, iz kojeg škole za vještice crpe svoje magične moći, napokon je pronađen. Esmerelda dolazi u posjet Ethel koja je nagovara da preuzme magičnu moć kamena, što ova odbija. No kako bi spasila njihovu mlađu sestru Sybil, Esmerelda to na kraju ipak učini, nakon čega stvari kreću po zlu i dvorac se ubrzo nađe okovan ledom. Dok Mildred, Maud, Enid i sestre Hallow pokušavaju pronaći način da "ožive" kamen temeljac, Mildred nabasa na svoje obiteljsko stablo. Otkriva da dolazi iz vještičje obitelji, no da se njezina pretkinja Mirabelle Hubble, kao i idućih 12 naraštaja, moralo odreći svojih moći kako bi ponovno udahnulo život kamenu temeljcu. Nakon što sve evakuiraju kako se ne bi smrznuli, Mildred shvati da i ona mora učiniti isto ako želi spasiti školu. Počne čarati, no prije nego što uspije izgovoriti čaroliju do kraja, profesorica likovnog, gđica Mould, uskače na njezino mjesto i žrtvuje svoje moći. R.: Dermot Boyd Ul.: Bella Ramsey (Mildred Hubble), Megan Hughes (Maud Spellbody), Tamara Smart (Enid Nightshade), Jenny Richardson (Ethel Hallow), Miriam Petche (Esmerelda Hallow)...

programme.title: Forests and people / Šume i ljudi
programme.desc: Forests and humans - (E06, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2002) In our continental wetland zones along the oak lužnjak is a key type of field ash. It also manages to grow in areas where the water is deep for the flood and several meters deep. In ancient times, the ash was symbolized by the whole world: the roots that underground, and the canopy of heaven. His poles have long been a valuable strategic material. The tough and the supple served as a spear. Jasenovina was irrep Today, ash is used in the parquet and furniture industry, right next to the oak. Conversations in the old Đakovo family collage workshop vividly illustrate the changes that the attitude towards Jasen experienced for the shifts of three generations. R .: Drazen Piškorić ... / Šume i ljudi - (E06, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2002) U našim kontinentalnim močvarnim zonama uz hrast lužnjak ključna je vrsta poljski jasen. Uspijeva rasti i na područjima na kojima je za poplava voda duboka i nekoliko metara. U davno doba jasen je simbolizirao cijeli svijet: korijenje onaj podzemni, a krošnja nebeski. Njegove motke dugo su bile dragocjen strateški materijal. Žilave i gipke služile su kao koplja. Jasenovina je bila nezamjenljiva u kolarstvu, izradi skija, saonica i u drugim drvodjelskim zanatima. Danas se jasen koristi u industriji parketa i namještaja, tik do hrastovine. Razgovori u staroj đakovačkoj obiteljskoj kolarskoj radionici zorno ilustriraju promjene koje je odnos prema jasenu doživio za smjene triju pokoljenja. R.: Dražen Piškorić...

programme.title: Sea, olive and vine: salty and sweet / More, Maslina i Loza: Slano i slatko
programme.desc: Sea, olive and vine: salty and sweet - (E02, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2002) What a frightening sea looks like when its waves stuck with storm rolling boats in Lucice as a straw, and then suddenly silences, calls his beauty to some magical, almost inexplicable power. In the small sea, as they call the Ston Bay, the living oyster, allegedly a Croatian product for the 21st century. This shell full of phosphorus and iron is the desire of many gourmets across Europe, and the hosts filled with the fear of a black plague in the bay invoke wit and power to keep that pearl of our sea. The vineyards and olives are the following low our island beauty from which hard work and love springs, spiced with warm winds of the south. "In my dreams, I have drawn in my dreamers of vineyards and olive Arabeska, combing the grape lace and listening to laughter in drinking wine, white and black, young and old, calm and sparkling, trying to grasp this mysterious harmony of the earth and the vine, heaven and man, because he is almost erotic in these territories in these territories. intoxication and traditional consistency expressed his existential surrender of vine and wine, vine and olives, "wrote prof. Dr. Mirošević. There is a long tradition of viticulture and olive growing in the Mediterranean. For millennia, the smell of wine and oil, fish and salt has been mixed, life flows through four harvests, sweet and salty, never cute and easily, more often difficult, sometimes pressed. R .: Dominik Zen ... / More, Maslina i Loza: Slano i slatko - (E02, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2002) Kako zastrašujuće more izgleda kada mu valovi potaknuti olujom valjaju barke u lučicama kao slamčice, a onda sve iznenada utihne, zov njegove ljepote mami nekom magičnom, gotovo neobjašnjivom snagom. U Malom moru, kako zovu Stonski zaljev, živi kamenica, navodno hrvatski proizvod za 21. stoljeće. Ta školjka puna fosfora i željeza želja je mnogih sladokusaca diljem Europe, a domaćini ispunjeni strahom od crne kuge u zaljevu prizivaju pamet i vlast da čuvaju taj biser našeg mora. Vinogradi i masline sljedeće su niske naše otočke ljepote iz kojih izvire težački rad i ljubav, začinjen toplim vjetrovima juga. "Čitavog sam svog života u svojim sanjarijama iscrtavao vinogradarske i maslinarske arabeske, pročešljavao grožđane čipke i osluškivao smijeh u ispijanju vina, bijelog i crnog, mladog i starog, mirnog i iskričavog, pokušavajući dokučiti tu misterioznu harmoniju zemlje i loze, neba i čovjeka, jer on je vjekovima na ovim našim prostorima gotovo erotskom senzualnošću, sugestivnom opijenošću i tradicijskom dosljednošću iskazivao svoje egzistencijalno predanje lozi i vinu, lozi i maslini", napisao je prof. dr. Mirošević. Duga je tradicija vinogradarstva i maslinarstva na Mediteranu. Već tisućljećima miješa se miris vina i ulja, ribe i soli, život teče kroz četiri berbe, slatko i slano, nikad preslatko i lako, češće teško, ponekad preslano. R.: Dominik Zen...

programme.title: Tenth Unit from Navarone / Deseta postrojba s Navaronea
programme.desc: Force 10 from Navarone - (Pust. Film, England, 1978) after successfully performing surgery on the Greek island of Navarone, Major Mallory (R. Shaw) and Sergeant Miller (E. Fox) in 1943, during heavy fighting throughout Europe, they find out that they are a new mission in front of them. Their task is to join an elite American unit called Force 10, led by Lieutenant Barnsby (H. Ford), and after the abduction of a military aircraft in the Italian thermolija, head to Yugoslavia, where they must demolish a strategically important bridge. But after their aircraft attacks the German Air Force during the flight, Mallory, Miller, Barknsby, Sergeant Weaver (C. Weathers) and Soldier Reynolds (A. Macinnes) will be saved from the demolished spacecraft. When they finally find themselves in the hills of Yugoslavia, they will be greeted by alleged partisans and allies led by Captain Drazak (R. Kiel). And when they discover that it is actually Chetniks, and when they fall into their captivity, the frenzy could help them attractive Marica (B. Bach), a lover of the German Major Schroeder (M. Byrne) ... R .: Guy Hamilton Ul.: Robert Shaw (Mallory), Harrison Ford (BARNSBY), Barbara Bach (Miller), Franco Nero (Lescovar) ... / Force 10 from Navarone - (pust. film, Engleska, 1978) Nakon uspješno obavljene operacije na grčkom otoku Navaroneu, bojnik Mallory (R. Shaw) i narednik Miller (E. Fox) 1943. godine, tijekom teških borbi u čitavoj Europi, doznaju da je pred njima nova misija. Njihov je zadatak pridružiti se elitnoj američkoj jedinici zvanoj Force 10 koju predvodi poručnik Barnsby (H. Ford), te nakon otmice vojnog zrakoplova u talijanskom Termoliju krenuti prema Jugoslaviji, gdje moraju srušiti strateški važan most. No nakon što njihov avion tijekom leta napadne njemačko ratno zrakoplovstvo, iz srušene letjelice spasit će se Mallory, Miller, Barnsby, narednik Weaver (C. Weathers) i vojnik Reynolds (A. MacInnes). Kad se napokon nađu u brdima Jugoslavije, ondje će ih dočekati navodni partizani i saveznici predvođeni kapetanom Dražakom (R. Kiel). A kad otkriju da je zapravo riječ o četnicima, te kad padnu u njihovo zarobljeništvo, u bijegu bi im mogla pomoći privlačna Marica (B. Bach), ljubavnica njemačkog bojnika Schroedera (M. Byrne)... R.: Guy Hamilton Ul.: Robert Shaw (Mallory), Harrison Ford (Barnsby), Barbara Bach (Maritza), Edward Fox (Miller), Franco Nero (Lescovar)...

programme.title: Memorial picture book - stone / Slikovnica uspomena - Kamen
programme.desc: Memorial picture book - stone - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2014) We return to the beginning, to the great -grandfather of our Genesis, to the place of some mysterious stonemalls who carved unknown stories of some ancient times. Like the center of the world, a place of shadows and illusion. In a speech without a word we open the door of the invisible. A place where we seek reality, calm, where nothing seems to be touched and disrupted and as if nothing has changed since the origin of the world to this day. And when we close a world with a stone, it seems to be completed but still unchanged. It is a place where man and God met celebrating beauty. Looking at the marks of many summers and winter, we remember another picture for the end. R .: Ljiljana Mandic ... / Slikovnica uspomena - Kamen - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2014) Vraćamo se na početak, u pradoba našeg postanka, na mjesto nekih tajanstvenih kamenorezaca koji su uklesali nepoznate priče nekih davnih vremena. Poput središta je svijeta, mjesto sjena i privida. U govoru bez riječi otvaramo vrata nevidljivoga. Mjesto gdje tražimo stvarnost, smirenje, gdje se čini da ništa ne treba dirati i poremetiti i kao da se ništa nije promijenilo od postanka svijeta do danas. I kad kamenom zatvorimo neki svijet, on se čini dovršenim, ali ipak nepromijenjenim. To je mjesto gdje su se Čovjek i Bog susreli slaveći ljepotu. Gledajući tragove mnogih ljeta i zima, pamtimo još jednu sliku za kraj. R.: Ljiljana Mandić...

programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: On the edge of science - (known. Pop. Series, Croatia) nothing has determined so much for the 20th century - and determines it to this day - as oil. But how did the oil industry develop? When and how did the famous Rockefeller family gained her first dominance over oil? What are the first main sites and how did they determine politics and influence the world wars? When were oil cartels formed? How are oil crises created and what is a wider geo -strategic image shows when it starts with the trail of oil? Nafa's story is partly a hidden history behind history ... / Na rubu znanosti - (znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska) Ništa nije toliko odredilo 20. stoljeće - a određuje ga sve do današnjih dana - kao nafta. No, kako se naftna industrija razvijala? Kada i kako je slavna obitelj Rockefeller stekla prvu dominaciju nad naftom? Koja su prva glavna nalazišta i kako su ona određivala politiku i utjecala na svjetske ratove? Kada su nastali naftni karteli? Kako su stvarane naftne krize i koja se šira geostrateška slika ukazuje kad se krene tragom nafte? Priča o nafti djelomično je i skrivena povijest iza povijesti...

programme.title: A new start with Ben Fogle / Novi početak s Benom Fogleom
programme.desc: Ben Fogle: Make a New Life in the Country - (S02, E06, Educational Program, England, 2022) The second season of the series in which Ben Fogle introduces us to adventure people who left work in the city, sold everything, went to the countryside and started a new life there. Ben has been following them for a full year - they will see how they left the city, invested savings in starting a new job and risked everything so they could be their masters themselves, live in a beautiful landscape and do what they love. She learns what obstacles they face and what their new everyday life looks like, and in a year it will reveal if the risk has paid off and whether the reality has fulfilled her expectations. R .: Lindsay Brown ... / Ben Fogle: Make a New Life in the Country - (S02, E06, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Druga sezona serije u kojoj nas Ben Fogle upoznaje s pustolovnim ljudima koji su ostavili posao u gradu, prodali sve, otišli na selo i ondje počeli novi život. Ben ih prati punu godinu dana - vidjet će kako su otišli iz grada, uložili ušteđevinu u pokretanje novog posla i sve riskirali kako bi mogli biti sami svoji gospodari, živjeti u lijepom krajoliku i raditi ono što vole. Doznaje s kakvim se zaprekama susreću i kako izgleda njihova nova svakodnevica, a za godinu dana otkrit će je li se rizik isplatio i je li stvarnost ispunila očekivanja. R.: Lindsay Brown...

programme.title: Photos in Croatia / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Photo in Croatia - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2016) Can the camera take a difference between the acting and real closeness of two people? How to monitor the growing up of nephews by recording his psychological states and resistance to educational methods? Is it hiding behind a "family exercise" a humorous departure from everyday routine or exploring new relationships within the family? To these questions, Petra is a slim answer - photos. Born in 1985 in Rijeka, she graduated in sociology and psychology, and then a photo at the Academy of Dramatic Arts in Zagreb. The photo becomes a medium for psychological and sociological research that preoccupies. In addition to photography, established concepts in contemporary society also prescribes collage, experimental video, installation and performance ... / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2016) Može li fotoaparat snimiti razliku između glumljene i stvarne bliskosti dvoje ljudi? Kako pratiti odrastanje nećaka bilježeći njegova psihološka stanja i otpor odgojnim metodama? Krije li se iza "Vježbanja obitelji" humoristični odmak od svakodnevne rutine ili istraživanje novih odnosa unutar obitelji? Na ta pitanja Petra Mrša odgovora - fotografijama. Rođena 1985. u Rijeci, diplomirala je sociologiju i psihologiju, a nakon toga fotografiju na Akademiji dramske umjetnosti u Zagrebu. Fotografija joj postaje medij za psihološka i sociološka istraživanja koja je zaokupljaju. Osim fotografijom, ustaljene koncepte u suvremenom društvu ona propituje i kolažem, eksperimentalnim videom, instalacijom i performansom...

programme.title: The sunny side of Prisavlje / Sunčana strana Prisavlja
