R .: Mirena Stijacic ... / Sunčana strana Prisavlja - (glazb. videoisječak, Hrvatska, 2021) U ciklusu koncerata Sunčane strane Prisavlja nastupa Ansambl narodnih plesova i pjesma Hrvatske LADO. Prema odabiru umjetničkog ravnatelja Krunoslava Šokca izvest će niz svojih, dosad već izvođenih i poznatih plesnih i glazbenih djela, nastalih nadahnutima folklornom baštinom različitih krajeva Hrvatske i prostora gdje žive Hrvati - Slavonije, Dalmacije, Prigorja, Posavine, Bačke... R.: Mirena Stijačić...

programme.title: ART / ART

Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) The show takes us to Sarajevo at the International Literature Festival "Bookstan", where with Nathan Thrall, an American journalist living in Jerusalem, we talked about the book "One Day of Abed Salam" about the absurdly difficult conditions of the Palestinian life on the West Coast, for which he received the Pulitzer award. The festival also featured new books published in the "Dnevnik" edition, designed by Semezdin Mehmedinovic, we watched and listened to the music-literary project "Walcers from Translajtania" Ahmed Buric in collaboration with Nenad Rizvanovic and more ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Emisija nas vodi u Sarajevo na međunarodni festival književnosti "Bookstan" gdje smo s Nathanom Thrallom, američkim novinarom koji živi u Jeruzalemu, razgovarali o knjizi "Jedan dan u životu Abeda Salame" o apsurdno teškim uvjetima života Palestinaca na Zapadnoj obali, za koju je dobio Pulitzerovu nagradu. Na festivalu su predstavljene i nove knjige objavljene u ediciji "Dnevnik" koju je osmislio Semezdin Mehmedinović, gledali smo i slušali muzičko-književni projekt "Valceri iz Translajtanije" Ahmeda Burića nastao u suradnji s Nenadom Rizvanovićem i još mnogo toga...

programme.title: From the animator / Animatik
programme.desc: Animatics - (Cult. Magazine, Croatia, 2025) At the beginning of the new television season, the show brings an overview of this year's editions of the two festivals. The first is the 21st International Festival of Experimental Film and Video 25 FPS, which takes place from 23 to 27 September in Zagreb, then from September 30 to October 3 in Rijeka and the second time in Split on October 30. The festival in the studio is discussed by the producer and selector of the 25 FPS Festival Nika Petković and director Tin Žanić, whose new film was included in the reflex festival program. Animatics' viewers will have the opportunity to see an experimental film in/divide (1999) by director Nicole Hewitt and the animated film Document Parakosmik (2018) by director Vladislav Knezevic. The new animatics also referred to this year's edition of the International Animated Film Festival in Annecy, which took place from June 8 to June 14th. R.: Gordana Bolcic ... / Animatik - (kult. magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Na početku nove televizijske sezone emisija donosi pregled ovogodišnjih izdanja dvaju festivala. Prvi je 21. internacionalni festival eksperimentalnog filma i videa 25 FPS, koji se održava od 23. do 27. rujna u Zagrebu, zatim od 30. rujna do 3. listopada u Rijeci te drugi put u Splitu 30. listopada. O festivalu u studiju govore producentica i selektorica Festivala 25 FPS Nika Petković te redatelj Tin Žanić, čiji je novi film Crnognoj uvršten u festivalski program Refleksi. Gledatelji Animatika imat će priliku vidjeti eksperimentalni film In/Dividu (1999.) redateljice Nicole Hewitt te animirani film Dokument Parakozmik (2018.) redatelja Vladislava Kneževića. Novi Animatik osvrće se i na ovogodišnje izdanje Međunarodnog festivala animiranog filma u Annecyju, koje se održalo od 8. do 14. lipnja. R.: Gordana Bolčić...

programme.title: 25 FPS - Kronka / 25 FPS - Kronika
programme.desc: 25 FPS - Chronicle - (E02, Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) Twenty -first edition of the 25 FPS Festival will be held from 23 to 27 September 2025 at the Zagreb Cinema Cinema, with a solemn opening at the Museum of Contemporary Art. After Zagreb, the festival travels to Rijeka Art-Chino (September 30, October 1 and 3) and to the Split Multimedia Cultural Center (October 30). The Festival will open an exhibition of Italian visual artist Rose Barba called "Meaning Distance" in MSU Zagreb on Tuesday, September 2nd. A total of 25 film titles will be shown in the international competition program, and 5 films in the Croatian Competition Program. According to the festival selector, Marina Kozul, Nika Petkovic and Tena Trstenjak, this year's selection of films is mostly run by the idea of ​​the end of the world we have caused ourselves. The big jury of the 21st Festival 25 FPS is British critic and theorist Erika Bals, Belgian curator Stoffel Debuysere and American director and artist Michael Robinson. The reward in reflections will be decided by the jury of criticism made up of Bartol Babic Vukmir, Dario Dunatov and Vanja Gajic. The festival will also be awarded the Audience Award and the Green DCP Award, which is awarded to Croatian film by the Audio-Visual Research Association of 25 FPS in selection. We also have a rich accompanying program, curled jury members, a panel on the topic of film festivals and their new reality and two audiovisual live performances ... / 25 FPS - Kronika - (E02, umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Dvadeset i prvo izdanje Festivala 25 FPS održat će se od 23. do 27. rujna 2025. u zagrebačkom kinu Kinoteka, uz svečano otvorenje u Muzeju suvremene umjetnosti. Nakon Zagreba, festival putuje u riječko Art-kino (30. rujna, 1. i 3. listopada), te u splitski Multimedijalni kulturni centar (30. listopada). Festival će u utorak 23. rujna otvoriti izložba talijanske vizualne umjetnice Rose Barbe pod nazivom "Meaning Distances" u MSU Zagreb, uz izbor njezinih skulpturnih filmskih instalacija. U međunarodnom natjecateljskom programu bit će prikazano ukupno 25 filmskih naslova, a u hrvatskom natjecateljskom programu Refleksi 5 filmova. Kako najavljuju selektorice festivala, Marina Kožul, Nika Petković i Tena Trstenjak, ovogodišnjom selekcijom filmova ponajviše se provlači ideja kraja svijeta koji smo sami uzrokovali. Veliki žiri 21. Festivala 25 FPS čine britanska kritičarka i teoretičarka Erika Balsom, belgijski kustos Stoffel Debuysere i američki redatelj i umjetnik Michael Robinson. O nagradi u Refleksima odlučivat će žiri kritike koji čine Bartol Babić Vukmir, Dario Dunatov i Vanja Gajić. Na festivalu će se dodijeliti i Nagrada publike te Nagrada Green DCP koji hrvatskom filmu u selekciji dodjeljuje Udruga za audio-vizualna istraživanja 25 FPS. Očekuje nas i bogati popratni program, kurirani programi članova žirija, panel na temu Filmski festivali i njihove nove stvarnosti te dva audiovizualna performansa uživo...

programme.title: Retrospectiva Alaina Delona: Jeff / Retrospektiva Alaina Delona: Jeff
programme.desc: Jeff - (Film, France, 1969) after a successful robbery leader Jeff disappears with prey, leaving associates without anything. Other members decide to get any information from Jeff's girlfriend Eve to all means of where their former money leader could be hidden. But Laurent, Jeff's right hand, refuses to participate in it and rebel against others. The angry robbers leave him trapped with one of the gang members, but Laurent manages to free himself and immediately rush to her. Together they start traveling and looking for Jeff, and eventually discover the truth. No Laurent, Jeffova desna ruka, odbija sudjelovati u tome i pobuni se protiv ostalih. Bijesni pljačkaši ostavljaju ga zarobljenoga s jednim od članova bande, no Laurent se uspijeva osloboditi i odmah odjuri k Evi. Zajedno kreću na putovanje i traže Jeffa, a naposlijetku otkriju istinu. His attempt at suicide and his father's death briefly briefly briefly brought him and his wife, but long suppressed dissatisfaction soon erupted again to the surface. programme.title: Forests and people / Šume i ljudi
programme.desc: Forests and people - (E07, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2002) Every year, during the summer, forest fires are caused by serious losses that are not just material. They significantly change environmental circumstances, endanger lives, penetrate settlements, interrupt the tourist season, ruin the natural and cultural heritage, impair hydrological relations. Passing small cattle grazing is an additional unfavorable factor. Poetic images of the healthy forests of our karst, dramatic actions of firefighters and canader crews, forestry interventions on the renovation of destroyed areas, and the depressed atmosphere of the burned areas show emotional charge. The canader pilots, a Franciscan from a monastery in Visovac, a shepherd from Promine, Director of Arboretum Trsteno and Forestry Expert, participate. R .: Drazen Piškorić ... / Šume i ljudi - (E07, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2002) Svake godine tijekom ljeta šumski požari Hrvatskoj nanose ozbiljne gubitke koji nisu samo materijalni. Oni bitno mijenjaju ekološke prilike, ugrožavaju živote, prodiru u naselja, prekidaju turističku sezonu, upropaštavaju prirodnu i kulturnu baštinu, narušavaju hidrološke odnose. Ispaša sitne stoke dodatni je nepovoljan faktor. Poetične slike zdravih šuma našega krša, dramatične akcije vatrogasaca i posada kanadera, šumarski zahvati na obnovi uništenih površina, te depresivna atmosfera izgorenih područja emisiji daju emocionalni naboj. Sudjeluju piloti kanadera, franjevac iz samostana na Visovcu, pastir s Promine, ravnatelj Arboretuma Trsteno i šumarski stručnjak. R.: Dražen Piškorić...

programme.title: Kornati / Kornati
programme.desc: Kornati - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2007) The Kornati archipelago is a marvelous maze of island, islets and cliffs. They seem enigmatic, wild and apparently desolate. It's a place of hidden differences. Like the cloud print, they change the shape with each wave, each sunlight. And the stone is alive here, whether he is a man or God's work. This is where the mainland and the blue sea are intertwined in which movements, sounds and shapes disappear, drowning in endless. This always lively blueness becomes the limit between God and us, the door to another world. We just tried to open that door, listening to the whisper of the sea, witnessing only one point from the Genesis of the World to the present. Filled with the magic of Kornati, the authors made this film in 2007. With the help of good people and the professional cooperation of Zlatko Ruzanovic. R .: Ljiljana Mandic ... / Kornati - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2007) Kornatski arhipelag je čudesan labirint otoka, otočića i hridi. Doimlju se zagonetno, divlje i prividno pusto. To je mjesto skrivenih razlika. Poput otiska oblaka su, svakim valom mijenjaju oblik, svakom sunčevom zrakom boju. I kamen je ovdje živ, bio on čovjekovo ili Božje djelo. Tu se isprepleću kopno i modro more u kojem pokreti, zvukovi i oblici nestaju, utapaju se u beskraju. To uvijek živo plavetnilo postaje granica između Boga i nas, vrata u neki drugi svijet. Ta smo vrata tek pokušali odškrinuti osluškujući šapat mora, svjedočeći samo jednom trenutku od postanka svijeta do danas. Ispunjeni čarolijom Kornata ovaj film autori su načinili 2007. uz pomoć dobrih ljudi i stručnu suradnju Zlatka Ružanovića. R.: Ljiljana Mandić...

Otkriva da dolazi iz vještičje obitelji, no da se njezina pretkinja Mirabelle Hubble, kao i idućih 12 naraštaja, moralo odreći svojih moći kako bi ponovno udahnulo život kamenu temeljcu. Nakon što sve evakuiraju kako se ne bi smrznuli, Mildred shvati da i ona mora učiniti isto ako želi spasiti školu. Počne čarati, no prije nego što uspije izgovoriti čaroliju do kraja, profesorica likovnog, gđica Mould, uskače na njezino mjesto i žrtvuje svoje moći. R.: Dermot Boyd Ul.: Bella Ramsey (Mildred Hubble), Megan Hughes (Maud Spellbody), Tamara Smart (Enid Nightshade), Jenny Richardson (Ethel Hallow), Miriam Petche (Esmerelda Hallow)...

programme.title: Forests and people / Šume i ljudi
programme.desc: Forests and people - (E07, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2002) Every year, during the summer, forest fires are caused by serious losses that are not just material. They significantly change environmental circumstances, endanger lives, penetrate settlements, interrupt the tourist season, ruin the natural and cultural heritage, impair hydrological relations. Passing small cattle grazing is an additional unfavorable factor. Poetic images of the healthy forests of our karst, dramatic actions of firefighters and canader crews, forestry interventions on the renovation of destroyed areas, and the depressed atmosphere of the burned areas show emotional charge. The canader pilots, a Franciscan from a monastery in Visovac, a shepherd from Promine, Director of Arboretum Trsteno and Forestry Expert, participate. R .: Drazen Piškorić ... / Šume i ljudi - (E07, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2002) Svake godine tijekom ljeta šumski požari Hrvatskoj nanose ozbiljne gubitke koji nisu samo materijalni. Oni bitno mijenjaju ekološke prilike, ugrožavaju živote, prodiru u naselja, prekidaju turističku sezonu, upropaštavaju prirodnu i kulturnu baštinu, narušavaju hidrološke odnose. Ispaša sitne stoke dodatni je nepovoljan faktor. Poetične slike zdravih šuma našega krša, dramatične akcije vatrogasaca i posada kanadera, šumarski zahvati na obnovi uništenih površina, te depresivna atmosfera izgorenih područja emisiji daju emocionalni naboj. Sudjeluju piloti kanadera, franjevac iz samostana na Visovcu, pastir s Promine, ravnatelj Arboretuma Trsteno i šumarski stručnjak. R.: Dražen Piškorić...

programme.title: Kornati / Kornati
programme.desc: Kornati - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2007) The Kornati archipelago is a marvelous maze of island, islets and cliffs. They seem enigmatic, wild and apparently desolate. It's a place of hidden differences. Like the cloud print, they change the shape with each wave, each sunlight. And the stone is alive here, whether he is a man or God's work. This is where the mainland and the blue sea are intertwined in which movements, sounds and shapes disappear, drowning in endless. This always lively blueness becomes the limit between God and us, the door to another world. We just tried to open that door, listening to the whisper of the sea, witnessing only one point from the Genesis of the World to the present. Filled with the magic of Kornati, the authors made this film in 2007. With the help of good people and the professional cooperation of Zlatko Ruzanovic. R .: Ljiljana Mandic ... / Kornati - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2007) Kornatski arhipelag je čudesan labirint otoka, otočića i hridi. Doimlju se zagonetno, divlje i prividno pusto. To je mjesto skrivenih razlika. Poput otiska oblaka su, svakim valom mijenjaju oblik, svakom sunčevom zrakom boju. I kamen je ovdje živ, bio on čovjekovo ili Božje djelo. Tu se isprepleću kopno i modro more u kojem pokreti, zvukovi i oblici nestaju, utapaju se u beskraju. To uvijek živo plavetnilo postaje granica između Boga i nas, vrata u neki drugi svijet. Ta smo vrata tek pokušali odškrinuti osluškujući šapat mora, svjedočeći samo jednom trenutku od postanka svijeta do danas. Ispunjeni čarolijom Kornata ovaj film autori su načinili 2007. uz pomoć dobrih ljudi i stručnu suradnju Zlatka Ružanovića. R.: Ljiljana Mandić...

programme.title: G. Deeds ide u grad / G. Deeds ide u grad
programme.desc: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town - (Comedy, USA, 1936) Dealous Longfellow Deeds (G. Cooper) is a modest guy from Mandrake Falls in Vermont, who lives a simple life and plays a tube in the local band. When he receives the notification that his Uncle Martin Semple was died who left him $ 20 million, Deeds is packed, took the tube and traveled to New York. There will be target for many greedy and ambitious people, from Uncle Lawyer John Cedar (D. Dumbrille) Cornelius Cobba (L. Stander), to the ambitious youth of the Bennett (J. Arthur) ... Р.: Frank Capra ul.: Gary Cooper (Longfellow Deeds), Jean Arthur (Louise "Babe" Bennett / Mary Dawson), Mac Wade, Lionel Stander, Douglass Dumbrille (John Cedar) ... / Mr. Deeds Goes to Town - (komedija, SAD, 1936) Dobrodušni Longfellow Deeds (G. Cooper) skroman je momak iz provincijskog gradića Mandrake Fallsa u Vermontu, koji živi jednostavnim životom i u lokalnom bendu svira tubu. Kad primi obavijest da je umro njegov ujak Martin Semple koji mu je oporučno ostavio 20 milijuna dolara, Deeds se spakira, uzme tubu i otputuje u New York. Ondje će postati meta za mnoge pohlepne i ambiciozne ljude, od ujakova odvjetnika Johna Cedara (D. Dumbrille), preko problematičnog bivšeg novinara Corneliusa Cobba (L. Stander), do ambiciozne mlade reporterke Louise "Babe" Bennett (J. Arthur)... R.: Frank Capra Ul.: Gary Cooper (Longfellow Deeds), Jean Arthur (Louise "Babe" Bennett/Mary Dawson), George Bancroft (Mac Wade), Lionel Stander (Cornelius Cobb), Douglass Dumbrille (John Cedar)...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) The show takes us to Sarajevo at the International Literature Festival "Bookstan", where with Nathan Thrall, an American journalist living in Jerusalem, we talked about the book "One Day of Abed Salam" about the absurdly difficult conditions of the Palestinian life on the West Coast, for which he received the Pulitzer award. The festival also featured new books published in the "Dnevnik" edition, designed by Semezdin Mehmedinovic, we watched and listened to the music-literary project "Walcers from Translajtania" Ahmed Buric in collaboration with Nenad Rizvanovic and more ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Emisija nas vodi u Sarajevo na međunarodni festival književnosti "Bookstan" gdje smo s Nathanom Thrallom, američkim novinarom koji živi u Jeruzalemu, razgovarali o knjizi "Jedan dan u životu Abeda Salame" o apsurdno teškim uvjetima života Palestinaca na Zapadnoj obali, za koju je dobio Pulitzerovu nagradu. Na festivalu su predstavljene i nove knjige objavljene u ediciji "Dnevnik" koju je osmislio Semezdin Mehmedinović, gledali smo i slušali muzičko-književni projekt "Valceri iz Translajtanije" Ahmeda Burića nastao u suradnji s Nenadom Rizvanovićem i još mnogo toga...

programme.title: From the animator / Animatik
programme.desc: Animatics - (Cult. Magazine, Croatia, 2025) The show is dedicated to the artistic short but also featurely animated films of Croatian and foreign authors, which will be in full. The animation, also, through contributions and talks with guests in the studio, thematizes certain aspects of work on animated film by showing both new and classic works of Croatia and world animation. The goal of the show is to regularly display animated films in the context of the topic so that viewers have the opportunity to see these titles in their full duration. Authors of animated films, members of film teams, film critics and filmmakers, and the organizers of the festival featuring animated films will be attended in Animatika through contributions and study conversations, film critics and filmmakers, depending on the central topic of the show ... / Animatik - (kult. magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Emisija je posvećena umjetničkim kratkometražnim, ali i dugometražnim animiranim filmovima hrvatskih i inozemnih autora, koji će se prikazivati u cijelosti. Animatik, također, kroz priloge i razgovore s gostima u studiju tematizira pojedine aspekte rada na animiranom filmu prikazujući i nova i klasična djela hrvatske i svjetske animacije. Cilj je emisije redovito prikazivati animirane filmove u kontekstu teme kako bi gledatelji imali prigodu vidjeti ove naslove u njihovu punom trajanju. U Animatiku će kroz priloge i studijske razgovore sudjelovati autori animiranih filmova, članovi filmskih ekipa, filmski kritičari i filmolozi te organizatori festivala na kojima se prikazuju animirani filmovi, i to ovisno o središnjoj temi emisije...

programme.title: Brazilian glow in the Alps / Brazilski sjaj u Alpama
programme.desc: Brazilian splendor in the alps - (Doc. Film, Austria, 2023) Today, Schladming is a well -known skiing destination, but did you know that the City Hall is located in a magnificent castle and that the Kruna stone on the second floor referred to the Brazilian Empire? Director Alexander Frohner reveals this secret to Schladming, following the trace of the descendants of the Austrian Archduke Leopoldine from Brazil to Austria. One of her heirs made Schladming with his main residence and attracted an international high nobility and artists from the entire Austro-Hungarian Empire to this alpine city. R.: Alexander Frohner ... / Brazilian Splendor in the Alps - (dok. film, Austrija, 2023) Danas je Schladming poznato skijaško odredište, no jeste li znali da se gradska vijećnica nalazi u veličanstvenom dvorcu i da kamena kruna na drugom katu upućuje na Brazilsko Carstvo? Redatelj Alexander Frohner razotkriva ovu tajnu Schladminga, prateći trag potomaka austrijske nadvojvotkinje Leopoldine od Brazila do Austrije. Jedan od njezinih nasljednika učinio je Schladming svojim glavnim prebivalištem i u ovaj alpski grad privukao međunarodno visoko plemstvo i umjetnike iz cijelog Austro-Ugarskog Carstva. R.: Alexander Frohner...

programme.title: Lanternist / Lanternist
programme.desc: Lantenist - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2009) Documentary film about going, a lighthouse on Stončica. Ivan Bulić Ićo has been working as a lighthouse since 1995. He changed several lighthous, from Blitvenica to Palagruza. He is currently working on Stončica, a lighthouse located on the east side of Vis. Ićo has one -month shifts, he is a month in Split, where he lives, and a month on the lighthouse. The Stončica is twenty minutes away from Vis by car and a twenty minute walk in a goat path. Sometimes friends from Vis or Split come to him. In his spare time, he closed himself in his little workshop and made fish from the wooden bouquets, which he has shown several times at exhibitions in Split, Vis and Zagreb. The film shows the life of a lighthouse, and through the story of Ivan Bulic it can be seen that loneliness is not conditioned by being alone somewhere. R .: Tanja Kanceljak ... / Lanternist - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2009) Dokumentarni film o Ići, svjetioničaru na Stončici. Ivan Bulić Ićo od 1995. godine radi kao svjetioničar. Promijenio je nekoliko svjetionika, od Blitvenice do Palagruže. Trenutačno radi na Stončici, svjetioniku smještenome na istočnoj strani Visa. Ićo ima jednomjesečne smjene, mjesec dana je u Splitu, gdje živi, a mjesec dana na svjetioniku. Stončica je udaljena od Visa dvadesetak minuta automobilom i još dvadesetak minuta hoda kozjom stazom. Ponekad mu dođu prijatelji iz Visa ili Splita. U slobodno vrijeme zatvori se u svoju malu radionicu i od drvenih naplavina izrađuje ribe koje je već nekoliko puta prikazao na izložbama u Splitu, Visu i Zagrebu. U filmu je prikazan život svjetioničara, a kroz priču o Ivanu Buliću vidi se da samoća nije uvjetovana time da si negdje sam. R.: Tanja Kanceljak...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Out of the format - (artistic program, Croatia), although everyone will say that we can find out nothing about Vlaho Bukovac anymore, the first out of format shows in the autumn scheme will deny it. Editor Ivana Antunović Jović spoke in the studio with the authors of the new documentary "Bukovac - Svjetlost, Roots and Wings", and the journalistic team went to Split at the Art Gallery in which the exhibition dedicated to Vlahu Bukovac and its almost unknown Split period ... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Iako će svi reći da o Vlahi Bukovcu više ništa novo ne možemo doznati, prva emisija Izvan formata u jesenskoj shemi to će demantirati. Urednica Ivana Antunović Jović u studiju razgovara s autorima novog dokumentarnog filma "Bukovac - svjetlost, korijeni i krila", a novinarska ekipa je otišla u Split u Galeriju umjetnina u kojoj je tek otvorena izložba posvećena Vlahi Bukovcu i njegovom gotovo nepoznatom splitskom razdoblju...

programme.title: Fever / Groznica
programme.desc: Rush! - (E01, Show Magazine, Australia, 2024) The episode explores the complex origin, global obsession and symbolic importance of valuable stone that really lasts eternal. From its beginnings as modest carbon deep below the Earth's covers to the founding of the Kimberley River with the global powerful de Beer at the helm, we explore the history of the industry under whose surfaces of incredible wealth there are social unrest. From the marketing campaign "The Diamond is Eternal", fever in Canada and Australia, to the colonial heritage of gemstones and transfer to the market and industry with greater environmental and ethical consciousness, we will find out that the eternal gemstone has gained its status in today's world. R .: Rob Perry Ul .: Mark Backes (Kommentar) ... / Rush! - (E01, show magazin, Australija, 2024) Epizoda istražuje složeno podrijetlo, globalnu opsesiju i simboličku važnost dragocjenog kamena koji doista traje vječno. Od svojih početaka kao skromnog ugljika duboko ispod Zemljina pokrivača do osnivanja rijeke Kimberley s globalnim moćnikom De Beerom na čelu, istražujemo povijest industrije ispod čije površine nevjerojatnog bogatstva stoje društveni nemiri. Od marketinške kampanje "Dijamant je vječan", groznica u Kanadi i Australiji, do kolonijalnog naslijeđa dragog kamenja te prelaska na tržište i industriju s većom ekološkom i etičkom sviješću, doznat ćemo kako je vječni dragi kamen stekao svoj status u današnjem svijetu. R.: Rob Perry Ul.: Mark Backes (Kommentar)...

programme.title: Eternal Comedy Cycle: Trst me, but love teach me / Vječni ciklus komedije: Muči me, ali ljubavi nauči me
programme.desc: Straziami Ma di throw Saziami - (Comedy, Italy, 1968), the Marino Balestrina shaver saw Marisa in Rome for the first time and love happened at first sight. Later, they meet again and consume their love, but Marisa's father opposes this relationship. Many obstacles always find themselves in the middle of the road, culminating in Marisa's wedding, after she believes that she has lost her Marina forever. Then for her husband he chooses a dull Umberto, and there are attempts at suicide that falls out like a farce. At the end of Marino and Maris, they try to kill Umberto, but they immediately regretted it. Still, everything is done well ... Risi: Dino Risi Ul.: Nino Manfredi (Marino Balestrini), Ugo Tognazzi (Umberto Ciceri), Pamela Tiffin (Marisa di Giovanni), Moira Orfei (Adelaide), Livio Lorenzon (Artemio di Giovanni) ... / Straziami ma di baci saziami - (komedija, Italija, 1968) Brijač Marino Balestrini prvi put ugleda Marisu u Rimu i dogodi im se ljubav na prvi pogled. Poslije se ponovno susretnu i konzumiraju svoju ljubav, no Marisin otac se protivi toj vezi. Brojne im se prepreke uvijek nađu nasred puta, što kulminira Marisinim vjenčanjem, nakon što ona povjeruje da je zauvijek izgubila Marina. Tad za muža odabere priglupog Umberta, a tu su i pokušaji samoubojstva koji ispadnu poput farse. Na kraju Marino i Marisa pokušaju ubiti Umberta, no to smjesta zažale. Ipak, sve dobro završi... R.: Dino Risi Ul.: Nino Manfredi (Marino Balestrini), Ugo Tognazzi (Umberto Ciceri), Pamela Tiffin (Marisa Di Giovanni), Moira Orfei (Adelaide), Livio Lorenzon (Artemio Di Giovanni)...

programme.title: Simpsons / Simpsoni
programme.desc: The Simpsons - (S33, E02, crt. Series, USA, 2021) Simpsons, animated series with the longest service of broadcasting, cultural institutions with an extremely loyal and dedicated circle of fans. Intelligently written, subversively humorous and cute humorous, the series ridicules the environment, but also itself. She has won numerous awards. The Simpsons are also the current owners of two Guinnes records, the longest aired animated series and series with the most hosting stars. The Simpson family consists of: Father Homer, who works as an occupational safety inspector in a local nuclear power plant, Mother Marge, who tries to keep peace in the family, a naughty ten -year -old Bart, an intelligent saxophonist of eight -year -old Lisa and the smallest Maggie, which emotions expresses a pier. Over time, viewers met and loved the remaining rich and infrequent unusual world of characters living in Springfield.sumpsoni, designed by animator Matt Groening, first appeared in 1987. As a series of short stories in 30 seconds, Groening produced for The Tracy Ullman Show. They soon received their own series, broadcasting for the first time in the Christmas special special on December 17, 1989, and then in the regular date of January 14, 1990. R .: Mike B. Anderson Ul .: Dan Castellanet (Mickey Mouse / Gramo Simpson / Homer Simpson), Julie Kavnr (Marge Simpson), Nancy Cartwright (Scammer / Nelson Muntz / Bart Simpson), Yeardley Smith (Lisa Simpson), Hank Azaria (Mac / Superingentent Chalmers / Scam-Fams Counciler / Raphael / Chief Wiggum / Moe Szyslak / Old Jewish Man) ... / The Simpsons - (S33, E02, crt. serija, SAD, 2021) Simpsoni, animirana serija s najduljim stažem emitiranja, kulturne institucije s izuzetno odanim i predanim krugom obožavatelja. Inteligentno pisana, subverzivno humoristična i simpatično duhovita, serija ismijava okolinu, ali i samu sebe. Dobitnica je brojnih nagrada. Simpsoni su uz to trenutačni vlasnici dva Guinnesova rekorda i to kao najdulje emitirana animirana serija i serija s najviše ugošćenih zvijezda. Obitelj Simpson čine: otac Homer, koji radi kao inspektor zaštite na radu u mjesnoj nuklearnoj elektrani, majka Marge, koja pokušava zadržati mir u obitelji, nestašni desetogodišnjak Bart, inteligentna saksofonistica osmogodišnja Lisa i najmanja Maggie, koja emocije izražava dudanjem. Gledatelji su s vremenom upoznali i zavoljeli preostali bogati i nerijetko neobični svijet likova koji žive u Springfieldu.Simpsoni, koje je osmislio animator Matt Groening, prvi su se put pojavili 1987. kao serija kratkih priča u 30 sekunda koje je Groening producirao za The Tracy Ullman Show. Uskoro su dobili vlastitu seriju emitiravši se prvi put u božićnom specijalu 17. prosinca 1989., a zatim i u redovnom terminu 14. siječnja 1990. Posjeduju svoju zvijezdu na holivudskoj Stazi slavnih, a 1. svibnja 2005. američka najzabavnija obitelj proslavila je tada rekordnu 350. epizodu. R.: Mike B. Anderson Ul.: Dan Castellaneta (Mickey Mouse / Grampa Simpson / Homer Simpson), Julie Kavner (Marge Simpson), Nancy Cartwright (Scammer / Nelson Muntz / Bart Simpson), Yeardley Smith (Lisa Simpson), Hank Azaria (Mac / Superintendent Chalmers / Scam-Fams Counciler / Raphael / Chief Wiggum / Moe Szyslak / Old Jewish Man)...

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: Fine and wine - (E02, Educational Program, Croatia) in the heart of Ljubljana is a place that connects three spaces, but also three visions of successful catering. Herzegovina pearls - Blatina and Žilavka - were the stars of the tenth Enogastro Blessed Festival, where lovers of good wines, food and fun gathered. On the island of Hvar in Zavali there is a scalinade, which in a word represents a paradise in which everything is subordinate to pure enjoyment. We continue to travel to Croatia, and this time we introduce you to the winemakers of Zagorje and their life stories. See which new wines were presented by the Belje Winery at the Osijek promotion ... / Fino i vino - (E02, obrazovni program, Hrvatska) U srcu Ljubljane nalazi se mjesto koje spaja tri prostora, ali i tri vizije uspješnog ugostiteljstva. Hercegovački biseri - blatina i žilavka - bili su zvijezde desetog enogastro festivala Blaž na kojemu su se okupili ljubitelji dobrih vina, hrane i zabave. Na otoku Hvaru u Zavali nalazi se Skalinada koja jednom riječju predstavlja raj u kojemu je sve podređeno čistom uživanju. Putujemo i dalje bregovitom Hrvatskom, a ovaj put vas upoznajemo s vinarima Zagorja i njihovim životnim pričama. Pogledajte koja je nova vina predstavila vinarija Belje na promociji u Osijeku...

programme.title: Rijeka: Sea / Rijeka: More
programme.desc: Rijeka: Sea - (Nature. Film, Croatia, 2025) There is almost no corner on a planet without plastic. She does not bypass our Adriatic either. What makes the Adriatic - we checked at the Sea Research Center in Rovinj. We travel to the Kvarner islands. On the island of Mala Srakana, there used to be about 50, and today only two people. We also introduce you to the interesting history of Voz Bay on the island of Krk. They are small, but they know everything about fishing and fish - there are more and more young people in Rijeka fishing clubs. In the section of the seas of the world, we discover the secrets of the northern Atlantic, and after the world we return to domestic waters, to Jablanac. We bring the story of the church of St. Nicholas - Jablanac Guardians ... / Rijeka: More - (prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2025) Gotovo da i nema kutka na planetu bez plastike. Ona ne zaobilazi ni naš Jadran. Što čini Jadranu - provjerili smo u Centru za istraživanje mora u Rovinju. Putujemo kvarnerskim otocima. Na otoku Male Srakane nekoć je živjelo 50-tak, a danas tek dvoje ljudi. Upoznajemo vas i sa zanimljivom poviješću uvale Voz na otoku Krku. Oni su mali, ali o ribolovu i ribama znaju sve - u riječkim ribolovnim klubovima sve je više mladih. U Rubrici morima svijeta otkrivamo tajne sjevernog Atlantika, a nakon svjetskih vraćamo se u domaće vode, i to u Jablanac. Donosimo priču o crkvici sv. Nikole - čuvarici Jablanca...

programme.title: Romano Bolkovic - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Romano Bolkovic - 1 to 1 - (Talk Show, Croatia) Vinzenz Stimpfl -Abel is a prominent Austrian strategy and communication expert, with extensive experience in the economy, politics and media, both in Austria and internationally. In addition to his professional engagement, he is the procurator of the Order of St. George of Habsburg-Lothringen, a knightly order that nurtures Christian, European and conservative values, and received the Golden Award of the Republic of Austria and the Knight's Cross of the Papal Order of Silvestra for his contribution to society 2024 and 2025. Stimpfl-Abel is a sought after lecturer, commentator and author of texts in domestic and international media. In an interview with him, we will look back at the current challenges of Europe, including the meaning of the term Mitteleurop, the role of Central Europe in the design of European politics, the issue of the European identity and morality crisis, and issues of freedom of speech and ideological norms. Particular attention will be paid to Vienna and its ability to re -assume an active role in the European cultural and political scene, as well as the impact of the Ukraine war on the safety and moral compass of the European Union. The conversation will also cover transatlantic relations, the position of Europe in the world, and the relevance of chivalry and symbolism of the Habsburg House and the Habsburg Order of St. George in Contemporary Society ... / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1 - (talk show, Hrvatska) Vinzenz Stimpfl-Abele je ugledni austrijski stručnjak za strategiju i komunikaciju, s bogatim iskustvom u gospodarstvu, politici i medijima, kako u Austriji tako i na međunarodnoj razini. Osim profesionalnog angažmana, prokurator je Reda svetog Jurja kuće Habsburg-Lothringen, viteškog reda koji njeguje kršćanske, europske i konzervativne vrijednosti, te je za svoj doprinos društvu 2024. i 2025. godine primio Zlatno odličje Republike Austrije i viteški križ Papinskog reda svetog Silvestra. Stimpfl-Abele je tražen predavač, komentator i autor tekstova u domaćim i međunarodnim medijima. U razgovoru s njim osvrnut ćemo se na aktualne izazove Europe, uključujući značenje pojma Mitteleuropa, ulogu Srednje Europe u oblikovanju europske politike, problematiku europske krize identiteta i morala, te pitanja slobode govora i ideoloških normi. Posebna pažnja bit će posvećena Beču i njegovoj mogućnosti da ponovno preuzme aktivnu ulogu u europskoj kulturnoj i političkoj sceni, kao i utjecaju rata u Ukrajini na sigurnost i moralni kompas Europske unije. Razgovor će također obuhvatiti transatlantske odnose, položaj Europe u svijetu, te relevantnost viteštva i simbolike Kuće Habsburg i Habsburškog Reda svetog Jurja u suvremenom društvu...

programme.desc: Rijeka: Sea - (Nature. Film, Croatia, 2025) There is almost no corner on a planet without plastic. She does not bypass our Adriatic either. programme.title: One for the Money / One for the Money
programme.desc: Stephanie Bloom (Catherine Hegel) inspected her work, works with her cousin (Fennie) as a prize and assigns her the issue of searching for the policeman Mooreli (Jason Omara), who is accused of killing one of his colleagues but facing some obstacles due to the cunning of Morley, and during her research she believes in the fairness of his case and discovers his innocence from the murder case and presented evidence of that. / تفقد ستيفاني بلوم (كاثرين هيجل) عملها، وتعمل مع ابن عمها (فيني) كصائدة للجوائز ويسند لها قضية البحث عن الشرطي مورللي (جيسون أومارا)، المتهم بقتل أحد زملائه ولكنها تواجه بعض العقبات نظرا لدهاء مورللي، وأثناء بحثها تؤمن بعدالة قضيته وتكتشف براءته من قضية القتل وتقدم دليلًا على ذلك.

programme.title: Hussein Ali Al Hawa / حسين على الهوا

programme.title: Raafat Al -Hajan c1 / رأفت الهجان ج1
programme.desc: The first part of the national epic, inspired by the story of the Egyptian spy (Rifaat Ali Suleiman Al -Jamal), which was planted within the Israeli society to spy in favor of Egyptian intelligence. (Mahmoud Abdel Aziz) Badro raised the beauty or Raafat Al -Hajan. In the first part, we get to know the front of the epic and the relationship of Raafat to the Egyptian intelligence, and we get to know his wife Helen Samon (Yusra). We follow his story in Egypt and the arrangement of Egyptian intelligence for his Jewish history in it and how he left Egypt to start the journey of spy against Israel in favor of Egyptian intelligence. / الجزء الأول من الملحمة الوطنية المستوحاة من قصة الجاسوس المصري (رفعت علي سليمان الجمال) الذي تم زرعه داخل المجتمع اﻹسرائيلي للتجسس لصالح المخابرات المصرية. يقوم (محمود عبد العزيز) بدرو رفعت الجمال أو رأفت الهجان. نتعرف في الجزء الأول على مقدمة الملحمة وعلاقة رأفت بالمخابرات المصرية، ونتعرف على زوجته هيلين سمحون (يسرا). نتابع قصته في مصر وترتيب المخابرات المصرية لتاريخه اليهودي فيها وكيفية خروجه من مصر ليبدأ رحلة الجاسوسية ضد إسرائيل لصالح المخابرات المصرية.

programme.title: Habib met / وتقابل حبيب
programme.desc: A wealthy woman discovers her husband's betrayal of her and marrying her, so she decides to separate from him and searches for a new love relationship, but she is involved in various conflicts that she did not expect, and her life changes with her gradually. / تكتشف امرأة ثرية خيانة زوجها لها والزواج عليها، فتقرر الانفصال عنه وتبحث عن علاقة حب جديدة، لكنها تتورط في صراعات مختلفة لم تكن تتوقعها، وتتغير معها حياتها تدريجيًا.

programme.title: Dalaa girls / دلع بنات
programme.desc: The series revolves around a comic framework about class differences in society through the story of two friends, one of which belongs to the popular class, while the other belongs to the bourgeois class, and this difference between them generates many paradoxes and comic situations. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار كوميدي حول الفوارق الطبقية في المجتمع من خلال قصة صديقتين، تنتمي إحداهما للطبقة الشعبية، بينما تنتمى الأخرى للطبقة البرجوازية، ويولد هذا الاختلاف بينهما العديد من المفارقات والمواقف الكوميدية.

programme.title: Faces / وجوه
programme.desc: The series of faces is divided into two stories: What are you, and Mitafs. The story of a doctor who graduated from the prison was presented to start a journey of searching for her daughter and the journey of facing psychosis. In Metaver, the heroine rejects life in reality and storms the virtual world to take revenge on its enemies. / ينقسم مسلسل وجوه إلى قصتين: وش تالت، وميتافرس. تقدم وش تالت قصة طبيبة تخرج من السجن لتبدأ رحلة بحث عن ابنتها ورحلة مواجهة مرض الذهان. أما في ميتافرس، ترفض البطلة الحياة في الواقع وتقتحم العالم الافتراضي لتنتقم لنفسها من أعدائها.

programme.title: With 100 men / بـ١٠٠ راجل
programme.desc: In a social dramatic framework, the events revolve around (Ghalia Abu Al -Dahab) that faces many troubles, and after the killing of her husband (Adel) during their wedding ceremony, (Ghalia) is forced to work as a microbus driver; And face many shocks, the most important of which is her imprisonment. / في إطار درامي اجتماعي، تدور الأحداث حول (غالية أبو الدهب) التي تواجه العديد من المتاعب، وبعد مقتل زوجها (عادل) خلال حفل زفافهما، تضطر (غالية) للعمل سائقة ميكروباص؛ وتواجه العديد من الصدمات أهمها دخولها السجن.

programme.title: Raya and Sakina / ريا وسكينة
programme.desc: The story of the life of the two sisters (Raya) and (Sakina), which are one of the most famous criminals of the twentieth century in Egypt. The women spared the beginning of the century and were behind the killing of dozens, and the series shows the circumstances that led to the transformation of the two sisters Raya and Sakina into two criminals, reviewing the developments of their lives and their access to those around them, and the impact of the environment in which the two sisters grew up on their future. / قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما.

programme.title: Arabi / العربجي
programme.desc: A dramatic epic that ignites fire from the womb of injustice and darkness, where the story of Abdo Al -Arabji, which works to transport goods on Tanbar; To support his family. However, Abu Hamza's injustice to him enter into conflicts with him and his son Hamza. Between hatred of a role, and the revenge of Drie Khanm - the wife of Abu Hamza's brother - how will Abdo face the intrigues? Will it remain for love from a place in the shadow of all these wars? / ملحمة درامية تُشعل النار من رحم الظلم والظلام، وذلك حيث قصة عبده العربجي، الذي يعمل على نقل البضائع على الطنبر؛ لإعالة عائلته. لكنّ ظلم أبو حمزة النشواتي له يُدخله في صراعات معه ومع ابنه حمزة. وبين حقد بدور، وانتقام دريّة خانم - زوجة شقيق أبو حمزة- كيف سيُواجه عبده المكائد؟ وهل سيبقى للحبّ من مكان في ظلّ كلّ هذه الحروب؟

programme.title: House of distress / بيت الشدة
programme.desc: A granddaughter and magician's granddaughter called (astronomer) returning to her grandfather's house, in order to take revenge on those who burned the house in the past, in light of a curse chasing her son Saif, which is the domination of the spirit of the grandfather on his body, and she finds herself in the face of the confrontation of the people of Al -Hara led by (Mukhtar) and soon things develop. / حفيدة مشعوذ وساحر تُدعى (فَلك) تعود إلى منزل جدها، لأجل الانتقام مِن مَن حرقوا المنزل قديمًا، في ظل وجود لعنة تطارد ابنها سيف وهي سيطرة روح الجد على جسده، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة تصدي أهل الحارة لها بقيادة (مختار) وسرعان ما تتطور الأمور.

programme.title: Faces / وجوه
programme.desc: The series of faces is divided into two stories: What are you, and Mitafs. programme.title: Moon face / وجه القمر
programme.desc: (Ibtisam Al -Bustani) is a television broadcaster, married to the businessman (Karim Abu Al -Ezz), showing her first husband (Mustafa Qura) again, who thought he died in a bombing accident in Lebanon during the civil war, and discovers that he did not die in the accident and that he was a arms dealer and fled after he had a bombing with a large wealth. / (ابتسام البستاني) مذيعة تلفزيونية، متزوجة من رجل الأعمال (كريم أبو العز)، يظهر من جديد زوجها اﻷول (مصطفى قورة) الذي ظنت أنه توفي في حادث تفجير في لبنان أثناء الحرب الأهلية، وتكتشف أنه لم يمت بالحادث وأنه كان تاجر سلاح وهرب بعد اصابته بعملية التفجير مع ثروة كبيرة.

programme.title: Fawazir events / فوازير المناسبات
programme.desc: In its episodes, Al -Fawazir deals with a daily question about a specific social occasion, which is embodied and represented through a comic story, and at the end of each episode a review of the occasion. / تتناول الفوازير في حلقاتها سؤال بشكل يومي عن مناسبة اجتماعية معينة، يتم تجسيدها وتمثيلها من خلال قصة كوميدية، وفي نهاية كل حلقة استعراض عن المناسبة.

programme.title: One Thousand and One Nights: Bride of the Sea / ألف ليلة وليلة: عروس البحور
programme.desc: A strange love story that grows between the human being, Prince Nour and Princess Arous, which does not have legs, but a tail like fish, and the bride of the sea tries to become human as her lover until her love succeeds. / قصة حب غريبة تنمو بين البشري الأمير نور والأميرة عروس البحر التي لا تمتلك ساقين وإنما ذيلًا مثل اﻷسماك، وتحاول عروس البحر أن تصير آدمية مثل حبيبها حتى ينجح حبها.

programme.desc: Salem falls into the trap of greed when he finds a treasure in the sea of ​​the sea, and his life quickly changes and escapes from his country, and soon the past returns to chase him while everyone tries to reach him to obtain their right to the treasure. / يسقط سالم في فخ الطمع حينما يعثر على كنز في بئر بقاع البحر، وسرعان ما تتغير حياته ويهرب من بلده، وسرعان ما يعود الماضي ليطارده بينما يحاول الجميع الوصول له للحصول على حقهم في الكنز.

programme.title: Word of men / كلام رجالة
programme.desc: The series deals with five stories of five women, including the working woman, the woman of society, the important wife of the man, and the corrupt lawyer, but what they collected is that they have replaced their husbands in managing home and family affairs, to decide to gather every Tuesday a week, discuss the problems of each of them, and try to solve them. / يتناول المسلسل خمس قصص لخمس نساء، منهن المرأة العاملة، وسيدة المجتمع، وزوجة الرجل المهم، وحرم المحامي الفاسد، ولكن ما جمعهن هو أنهن حللن محل أزواجهن في إدارة شئون البيت والأسرة، ليقررن التجمع كل يوم ثلاثاء في الأسبوع، ومناقشة مشاكل كل واحدة منهن، ومحاولة حلها.

programme.title: In the blink of an eye / في غمضة عين
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around (Fatima) and (Nabila), two friends, who were raised together with one of the orphans, until they worked two supervisors in the same shelter, suffering from the cruelty of life in the shelter, until Nabila discovers that she has a wealthy uncle and she goes to see him, and on the way an accident occurs and her friend believes that she died, and events escalate. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول (فاطمة) و(نبيلة) وهما صديقتان، تربيتا معاَ بأحد ملاجيء الأيتام، حتى عملتا مشرفتين في الملجأ نفسه، تعانيان من قسوة الحياة في الملجأ، حتى تكتشف نبيلة أن لها عم ثري فتذهب لرؤيته، وفي الطريق تقع حادثة وتعتقد صديقتها أنها ماتت، وتتصاعد الأحداث.

programme.title: Asmahan / أسمهان
programme.desc: The work deals with the life story of the late singer Asmahan, from her birth until her transfer from Beirut to Cairo to work as a singer and actress, to shine her name next to her brother Farid Al -Atrash, and the series touches on her relationship with some of the artists who lived with her until her mysterious death. / يتناول العمل قصة حياة المطربة الراحلة أسمهان، منذ ميلادها حتى إنتقالها من بيروت إلى القاهرة للعمل كمطربة وممثلة، ليلمع اسمها بجوار شقيقها فريد الأطرش، ويتطرق المسلسل إلى علاقتها ببعض الفنانين الذين عاصروها وحتى حادث وفاتها الغامض.

programme.title: Delivery groom / عريس دليفري
programme.desc: A simple young man dies his parents without leaving any inheritance for him, and his condition is bad and admires the girl of the daughter of an employee with his father. At the same time, he gets to know the daughter of a businesswoman who owns a hotel in which that young man works, so the mother tries to do what he can to remove her daughter. / شاب بسيط يتوفى والديه دون أن يتركا له اي ميراث فتسوء حالته ويعجب بفتاة ابنة احد الموظفين لدى والده وف الوقت ذاته يتعرف على ابنة سيدة أعمال تمتلك فندقًا يعمل فيه ذلك الشاب فتحاول اﻷم بذل ما في وسعها ﻹبعاده عن ابنتها.

programme.title: Disobedience c 1 / العصيان ج1
programme.desc: Social drama, which discusses the human relations interfering between members of the same family, especially if they are exposed to the temptation of money and does it spoil the souls of human beings to the degree that makes the son covet the money of his father and asks for stone on him under pressure and his wife is urgent. / دراما إجتماعية، تناقش العلاقات الإنسانية المتداخلة بين أفراد الأسرة الواحدة وخاصة إذا ما تعرضوا لإغراء المال وهل يفسد نفوس البشر للدرجة التى تجعل الإبن يطمع فى مال أبيه ويطلب الحجر عليه تحت ضغط والحاح زوجته.

programme.title: Digger / الحفار
programme.desc: After the occupation of the Sinai Peninsula by the Israeli forces in 1967 and the outbreak of the war of attrition, Israel announced that it had carried out extensive operations to excavate oil in the Sinai and rent a digger to carry out this task, and this matter has only one purpose, which is to show the Egyptian authorities with the appearance of a little trick in front of what Israel is doing, which prompted the Egyptian intelligence to plan to deal with the digger before reaching the door. / بعد احتلال شبه جزيرة سيناء من قبل القوات الإسرائيلية في عام 1967 واندلاع حرب الاستنزاف، أعلنت إسرائيل عن قيامها بعمليات موسعة للتنقيب عن البترول في سيناء وتأجير حفار للقيام بهذه المهمة، وهذا الأمر ليس له سوى غرض واحد، وهو إظهار السلطات المصرية بمظهر العاجز قليل الحيلة أمام ما تقوم به إسرائيل، وهو ما دفع المخابرات المصرية للتخطيط من أجل التعامل مع الحفار قبل وصوله إلى باب المندب.

programme.title: A rich man .. very poor / رجل غني .. فقير جدًا
programme.desc: The events revolve around a man who becomes a billionaire, and he believes that he owned the world, including, and then discovers that he is very poor because he lacks peace of mind and reassurance, and this is due to reasons, including the continuous American threats of the life of the big Arab family. / تدور الأحداث حول رجل يصبح مليارديرًا، فيعتقد أنه امتلك العالم بما فيه، ثم يكتشف أنه فقير جدًا لأنه يفتقد راحة البال والطمأنينة، ويعود هذا الى أسباب منها التهديدات الأميركية المستمرة لحياة الأسرة العربية الكبيرة.

programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. programme.title: Euroleague. Dubai Basketball - Partizan Mozzart Beth Belgrade / EuroLeague. Dubai Basketball - Partizan Mozzart Bet Belgrade
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. programme.title: Rajske garden / Rajske zahrady
programme.desc: The composition of the park near Podbořany represents an admirable synthesis of period influences and stimuli transformed into the Central European environment and the Czech landscape. The basic motifs refer to the type of Jardin Poetique, English and French influences and inspirations. First of all, it is necessary to emphasize the overall landscape context of the park. It is primarily a central forest part with a crop that forms the largest part of the parking and has a basic and determining meaning for it. Around the forest, in connection with its edges or on the valley and watercourses, individual thematic units and scenery appear, initially open to the landscape. The mythical Arcadia is transformed into a Central European historical space full of mysterious forest parts. / Kompozice parku u Podbořan představuje obdivuhodnou syntezu dobových vlivů a podnětů transformovaných do středoevropskeho prostředí a česke krajiny. Základní motivy odkazují k typu jardin poetique, k anglickým i francouzským vlivům a inspiracím. V první řadě je potřeba zdůraznit celkový krajinný kontext parku. Je to především ústřední lesní partie s porostem, který tvoří největší část parkove úpravy a má pro ni základní a určující význam. Kolem lesa se v návaznosti na jeho okraje nebo na údolí a vodní toky objevují jednotlive tematicke celky a scenerie, zpočátku otevřene do krajiny. Bájná Arkádie je transformována do středoevropskeho historickeho prostoru plneho tajemných lesních partií.

programme.desc: More than famous victories, the legend of motorcycle sport František Šťastný and famous for his falls. If a normal mortal has at least one guardian of Strážne over him, over him, there had to be a whole regiments. Since his first serious injury in 1944, when he fell in a corner, he broke his nose and was unconscious for ten minutes, and during his racing career, his doctors treated him thirty -three fractures. There were more than 25 medals from the world championships. The evidence of a dare style of driving, his stick, so perhaps only put it asleep and in a car when he was rushing at the Ford Fiesta Cup races. There (on the circle in Most), director Jiří Věrčák spent one of the two shooting days when he filmed his portrait for the Genus cycle in 1995. programme.title: Death in the Pacific - The last trip of the USS "Indianapolis" / Tod im Pazifik - Die letzte Fahrt der USS "Indianapolis"
programme.desc: It was the US freighter who transported the components of the atomic bomb for Hiroshima in secret mission. Neither crew nor Kapitan knew about the death freight. A few days after this trip in July 1945, the pride of the US Navy was torpedoed by a Japanese submarine. The oceangant drops within minutes - 900 of almost 1200 crew members succeed in leaving the ship. But nobody in the US Navy knows about their fate and so the shipwrecked are at the mercy of a tough struggle for survival. Not only heat, hunger and thirst rely on them, they are also stuck and attacked by Haischken. Only a few are saved. A state -of -the -art location boat is looking for decades later looking for the wreck in the Pacific and the few survivors of that time describe their agonizing fight against death in the Pacific. / Es war jener US-Frachter, der die Bestandteile der Atombombe fur Hiroshima in geheimer Mission transportiert hat. Weder Besatzung noch Kapitan wussten von der todlichen Fracht. Wenige Tage nach dieser Fahrt im Juli 1945 wurde der Stolz der US-Marine von einem japanischen U-Boot torpediert. Innerhalb von Minuten sinkt der Ozeangigant - von knapp 1200 Besatzungsmitgliedern gelingt es zwar 900, das Schiff zu verlassen. Aber niemand in der US-Marine weiSS von ihrem Schicksal und so sind die Schiffbruchigen einem beinharten Überlebenskampf ausgeliefert. Nicht nur Hitze, Hunger und Durst setzen ihnen zu, sie werden auch standig von Haischwarmen umkreist und attackiert. Nur wenige werden gerettet. Ein hochmodernes Ortungsboot macht sich Jahrzehnte spater auf die Suche des Wracks im Pazifik und die wenigen Überlebenden von damals schildern ihren qualvollen Kampf gegen den Tod im Pazifik.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson: Black + White / Oscar Peterson: Black + White
programme.desc: The Canadian jazz pianist Oscar Peterson was a legend during his lifetime. On the occasion of his birthday, which is on August 15 for the 100th time, the ORF shows a portrait of the piano virtuoso. Oscar Peterson is considered one of the most technically refined and melodic pianists in the history of jazz as the "Maharaja of the Key" as Duke Ellington. In his more than 70-year career, he published 200 own albums and is to be heard on around 400 others, sold more records and gave more concerts than any other pianist in the history of jazz. For his film, Barry Avrich has compiled the Impunized archive excerpts from interviews and concert recordings and let music-sized like Ella Fitzgerald, Quincy Jones, Herbie Hancock and Billy Joel have their say. / Der kanadische Jazzpianist Oscar Peterson war schon zu Lebzeiten eine Legende. Anlasslich seines Geburtstags, der sich am 15. August zum 100. Mal jahrt, zeigt der ORF ein Portrat des Klaviervirtuosen. Von niemand Geringerem als Duke Ellington als der "Maharaja der Tasten" bezeichnet, gilt Oscar Peterson als einer der technisch raffiniertesten und melodisch innovativsten Pianisten in der Geschichte des Jazz. In seiner mehr als 70-jahrigen Karriere hat er 200 eigene Alben veroffentlicht und ist auf etwa 400 weiteren zu horen, hat mehr Platten verkauft und mehr Konzerte gegeben als jeder andere Pianist in der Geschichte des Jazz. Barry Avrich hat fur seinen Film unzahlige Archiv-Ausschnitte aus Interviews und Konzertaufnahmen zusammengetragen und lasst Musik-GroSSen wie Ella Fitzgerald, Quincy Jones, Herbie Hancock und Billy Joel zu Wort kommen.

programme.title: Crime scene / Tatort

Statt Leben zu retten versetzen Herzimplantate der Firma Lauber Cardio ihren Tragerinnen und Tragern todliche StromstoSSe. programme.title: Franco - The Spanish dictator / Franco - Der spanische Diktator
programme.desc: E01 In November 2025, the death of the last dictator of Western Europe for the 50th time. Francisco Franco, known as "El Caudillo" (the warlord), ruled undisputed for almost 40 years. An incredible durability, a nightmare that the now democratic Spain still wears the scars. Franco was underestimated for a long time, but he ruled Langer than any of his fascist colleagues. And - unlike Hitler or Mussolini - he was finally accepted by the democracies. After four decades of tyranny, he died in his own bed in November 1975. How was that possible? How did he manive to stay in power? After the seizure of power with the Military Putsch in 1936, Franco started a crusade against the Republic with the help of the Catholic Church - and did not cope to destroy his opponents into tens of thousands. He is a monster for many. But despite his crimes, many activists still honor him today. / E01 Im November 2025 jahrt sich der Todestag des letzten Diktators Westeuropas zum 50. Mal. Francisco Franco, bekannt als "El Caudillo" (der Kriegsherr), regierte fast 40 Jahre lang unangefochten. Eine unglaubliche Langlebigkeit, ein Albtraum, von dem das inzwischen demokratische Spanien noch immer die Narben tragt. Franco wurde lange Zeit unterschatzt, aber er regierte langer als jeder seiner faschistischen Mitstreiter. Und - anders als Hitler oder Mussolini - wurde er schlieSSlich von den Demokratien akzeptiert. Nach vier Jahrzehnten der Tyrannei starb er im November 1975 in seinem eigenen Bett. Wie war das moglich? Wie hat er manovriert, um an der Macht zu bleiben? Nach der Machtergreifung mit dem Militarputsch von 1936 startete Franco mit Hilfe der katholischen Kirche einen Kreuzzug gegen die Republik - und zogerte nicht, seine Gegner zu Zehntausenden zu vernichten. Fur viele ist er ein Monster. Doch trotz seiner Verbrechen ehren ihn viele Aktivisten auch heute noch.

programme.title: Franco - The Spanish dictator / Franco - Der spanische Diktator
programme.desc: E02 After General Franco had come to power through a coup, he manoved from 1939 to his death in 1975 to keep control. While his former compromised Hitler and Mussolini disappeared at the end of the Second World War, his political durability remains surprising. How did this torn, patient, calculating and power -hungry man be able to improve a large part of the Spanish population from the fact that he was the country's rescuer? / E02 Nachdem General Franco durch einen Putsch an die Macht gekommen war, manovrierte er von 1939 bis zu seinem Tod im Jahr 1975, um die Kontrolle zu behalten. Wahrend seine einstigen Verbundeten Hitler und Mussolini mit dem Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs verschwanden, bleibt seine politische Langlebigkeit uberraschend. Wie gelang es diesem gerissenen, geduldigen, berechnenden und machthungrigen Mann, einen groSSen Teil der spanischen Bevolkerung davon zu uberzeugen, dass er der Retter des Landes war?

programme.title: Europe's forgotten dictatorships / Europas vergessene Diktaturen
programme.desc: S01E02 Portugal is the scene of the longest right dictatorship of modern Europe. The "Estado Novo" dominates the country for over 40 years. At the top: Antonio de Oliveira Salazar. In 1932 he became head of government and rises to become the sole ruler. Salazar pursues one goal uncompromisingly: preserved the colonial kingdom. He succeeds in keeping Portugal out of the Second World War, but the country remains in poverty and jerkiness. His famous secret police Pide represses every opposition. During her rings, she uses torture, people are arbitrarily arrested and imprisoned over months. The pide also experiences support from western countries. Because: Antonio de Oliveira Salazar is a strict Catholic and loathes communism. He stands on the side of the West, Portugal even became a basic member of NATO in 1949. The other member states accept the dictatorial circumstances in Salazar's Portugal approving - a ... / S01E02 Portugal ist Schauplatz der langsten rechten Diktatur des modernen Europas. Über 40 Jahre beherrscht der "Estado Novo" das Land. An seiner Spitze: Antonio de Oliveira Salazar. Im Jahr 1932 wird er Regierungschef und erhebt sich zum Alleinherrscher. Salazar verfolgt kompromisslos ein Ziel: das Kolonialreich erhalten. Es gelingt ihm zwar, Portugal aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg herauszuhalten, doch das Land verharrt in Armut und Ruckstandigkeit. Seine beruchtigte Geheimpolizei PIDE unterdruckt jede Opposition. Bei ihren Verhoren setzt sie Folter ein, Menschen werden willkurlich verhaftet und uber Monate hinweg inhaftiert. Unterstutzung erfahrt die PIDE auch aus dem westlichen Ausland. Denn: Antonio de Oliveira Salazar ist strenger Katholik und verabscheut den Kommunismus. Er stellt sich auf die Seite des Westens, Portugal wird 1949 sogar Grundungsmitglied der NATO. Die anderen Mitgliedsstaaten nehmen die diktatorischen Verhaltnisse in Salazars Portugal billigend in Kauf - ein...

programme.title: Europe's forgotten dictatorships / Europas vergessene Diktaturen
programme.desc: Modern Europe is now considered a merger of solid and liberal democracies. Dictatorships were even able to stay in Greece and Portugal until the mid -1970s. The path of these landers to democracy was hardly easier than that of other authoritated systems. ORF III shows two of the last dictatorships in Europe and documented how the West and other actors have understood these brutal and repressive systems until the end. April 21, 1967 - Tanks roll through Athens. It is the beginning of a military dictatorship in the middle of Europe, commanded by Greek officers and driven by hatred to the communists. Under the command of Colonel Georgios Papadopoulos, the Militars implement a coup plan, which NATO developed in the fight against communism. In just one night, the Obrists secure the power over Greece. Already in the first days after the coup, thousands of communists and left -wing oppositioners ... / Das moderne Europa gilt heute als Zusammenschluss gefestigter und freiheitlicher Demokratien. Dabei konnten sich Diktaturen bis in die Mitte der 1970er Jahre sogar in Griechenland und Portugal halten. Der Weg dieser Lander in die Demokratie war kaum einfacher als der von anderen autoritaren Systemen. ORF III zeigt zwei der letzten Diktaturen Europas und dokumentiert, wie der Westen und andere Akteure diese brutalen und repressiven Systeme bis zuletzt unterstutzt haben. 21. April 1967 - Panzer rollen durch Athen. Es ist der Beginn einer Militardiktatur mitten in Europa, befehligt von griechischen Offizieren und getrieben vom Hass auf die Kommunisten. Unter dem Befehl von Oberst Georgios Papadopoulos setzen die Militars einen Putschplan um, der von der NATO im Kampf gegen den Kommunismus entwickelt wurde. In nur einer Nacht sichern sich die Obristen so die Macht uber Griechenland. Schon in den ersten Tagen nach dem Putsch werden Tausende Kommunisten und linke Oppositionelle...

programme.title: On the Styrian alpine pastures / Auf den steirischen Almen
programme.desc: E79 wood traps, set up bander fence, cutting back, looking up, looking after alpine horses - many professions on the Alm can usually only be done by hand today. It is a severe body work, not indiscriminate, but it leaves a day's work that people are proud of. Wolfgang Scherz and Werner Huemer accompanied several workers in the Styrian Alps on their daily activity. Among other things, they were at the ward manager Brendlalm, at the Harrer Huttenwirtin, at the wague, when swinging and taking a look into the past of the wooden servants. / E79 Holzfallen, Banderzaune aufstellen, Gebusch zuruckschneiden, Almpferde betreuen - viele Berufe auf der Alm sind auch heute meistens nur von Hand zu erledigen. Es ist eine schwere korperliche Arbeit, nicht ungefahrlich, aber sie hinterlasst ein Tagwerk, auf das die Menschen stolz sind. Wolfgang Scherz und Werner Huemer haben mehrere Arbeiterinnen und Arbeiter in den steirischen Alpen bei ihren taglichen Tatigkeiten begleitet. Sie waren unter anderem bei der Stationsleiterin Brendlalm, bei der Harrer Huttenwirtin, beim Sagewerk, beim Schwenden und werfen auch einen Blick in die Vergangenheit der Holzknechte.

programme.title: From Hutte to Hutte on the Carnic comb / Von Hutte zu Hutte am karnischen Kamm
programme.desc: This "Land of Mountains" new production is overwhelming: in the deepest Suden of Austria, on the border with Italy, the Carnic comb, a historic mountain range, where thousands of Easter and Italian soldiers were opposed to each other in the First World War. Today the 150 km long Karnische Hohenweg, which is also called Friedensweg or via della pace, runs on the former fate ridge. The Karnische Hohenweg runs along the border ridge between Sudtirol, the Esterreichische Bundeslanden East Tyrol and Karnten, as well as the Italian provinces of Belluno and Udine. This film deals with magically situated hat on the mountain and the people who operate them: their enthusiasm for simplicity and fascination to beat a brood between silence on the one hand and the tourist attractions on the other hand, of passion and the characteristics that are necessary to keep the conditions on the mountain far from comfort and ... / Diese "Land der Berge"-Neuproduktion ist grenzuberschreitend: Im tiefsten Suden Österreichs, an der Grenze zu Italien, verlauft der Karnische Kamm, ein geschichtstrachtiger Gebirgszug, wo einander im Ersten Weltkrieg tausende osterreichisch-ungarische und italienische Soldaten gegenuberstanden. Heute verlauft am ehemaligen Schicksalsgrat der 150 km lange Karnische Hohenweg, der auch Friedensweg oder Via della Pace genannt wird. Der Karnische Hohenweg verlauft entlang des Grenzkammes zwischen Sudtirol, den osterreichischen Bundeslandern Osttirol und Karnten, sowie den italienischen Provinzen Belluno und Udine. Dieser Film handelt von magisch gelegenen Hutten am Berg und den Menschen, die sie betreiben: Von ihrer Begeisterung fur die Einfachheit und der Faszination, eine Brucke zu schlagen zwischen der Stille einerseits und den touristischen Anspruchen andererseits, von der Leidenschaft und den Eigenschaften, die notig sind, um den Bedingungen am Berg fernab von Komfort und...

programme.title: The Styrian Ennstal - Life on the River / Das steirische Ennstal - Leben am Fluss
programme.desc: The Styrian Ennstal extends over 125 km in Styria. Picturesque landscapes, a powerful river, embedded in a gentle valley with steep mountains, as well as exciting historical facts make the Ennstal something very special that the film wants to discover. "The Red Faden" of the film about the Ennstal is the Enns - the river, which geologically separates the crystalline central alps from the northern lime scenes. Not only the impressive landscape flora and fauna plays an important role on the cinematic journey, but also the story that hides behind this river. A film by Alfred Ninaus. / Das Steirische Ennstal erstreckt sich uber 125 km in der Steiermark. Malerische Landschaften, ein machtiger Fluss, eingebettet in einem sanften Tal mit steilen Gebirgen, sowie spannende historische Fakten machen das Ennstal zu etwas ganz Besonderem, das der Film entdecken will. "Der rote Faden" des Films uber das Ennstal ist die Enns - der Fluss, der geologisch die kristallinen Zentralalpen von den nordlichen Kalkalpen trennt. Nicht nur die beeindruckende landschaftliche Flora und Fauna spielt auf der filmischen Reise eine wesentliche Rolle, sondern auch die Geschichte, die sich hinter diesem Fluss verbirgt. Ein Film von Alfred Ninaus.

programme.title: Meryn on Monday / MERYN am Montag
programme.desc: Heart racing, unrest, dizziness or shortness of air - the typical symptoms of atrial fibrillation can be. Some affected traces also an irregular palpitations, while the disease in others remains completely unnoticed. Attach fibrillation is the most common form of cardiac arrhythmias. The front of the heart beat irregularly and very quickly, which can lead to uncoordinated blood flow. There is a major risk in the formation of blood clots that can cause a stroke. So how is atrial fibrillation treated? And what role do lifestyle factors such as food, exercise or stress play? Siegfried Meryn answers her questions together with Jolanta Siller-Matula, specialist for internal medicine and cardiology, in Meryn on Monday. Send us your questions or experience by email to medical@orf.at or via WhatsApp at +43/1/87878-25614. / Herzrasen, Unruhe, Schwindel oder Luftnot - das konnen typische Symptome von Vorhofflimmern sein. Manche Betroffene spuren auch ein unregelmaSSiges Herzklopfen, wahrend die Erkrankung bei anderen vollig unbemerkt bleibt. Vorhofflimmern ist die haufigste Form von Herzrhythmusstorungen. Dabei schlagen die Vorhofe des Herzens unregelmaSSig und sehr schnell, was zu einem unkoordinierten Blutfluss fuhren kann. Ein wesentliches Risiko besteht in der Bildung von Blutgerinnseln, die einen Schlaganfall verursachen konnen. Wie wird Vorhofflimmern also behandelt? Und welche Rolle spielen Lebensstilfaktoren wie Ernahrung, Bewegung oder Stress? Siegfried Meryn beantwortet Ihre Fragen zusammen mit Jolanta Siller-Matula, Facharztin fur Innere Medizin und Kardiologie, in MERYN am Montag. Schicken Sie uns Ihre Fragen oder Erfahrungen per Mail an medizin@orf.at oder via WhatsApp unter +43/1/87878-25614.
